    await _prepare(db)
    ai = FakeChapterAi()
    result = await DraftChapters(ai, db.session).run(_ctx())
    assert result["status"] == "skipped"
    assert not ai.requests


async def test_job_without_workspace_is_skipped(db) -> None:
    assert (await DraftChapters(FakeChapterAi(), db.session).run(_ctx()))[
        "status"
    ] == "skipped"


async def test_job_drafts_unwritten_prose_chapters_into_proposals(db) -> None:
    service = await _prepare(db)
    await MapEditor(db.session, 1, "Anna").add_activity(0, "Bestellen")
    async with db.session() as session:
        session.add(
            StatementEntity(offer_id=1, type=StatementType.ASSUMPTION, text="X")
        )
    await service.save(
        "laufzeit", 1, ProseContent(blocks=[Paragraph(runs=[Run(text="Hand")])])
    )
    await service.set_protected("loesung", True)
    ai = FakeChapterAi()
    result = await DraftChapters(ai, db.session).run(_ctx())
    keys = {p.chapter_key for p in await _proposals(db)}
    assert "management_summary" in keys
    assert "laufzeit" not in keys  # written by a person
    assert "loesung" not in keys  # protected
    assert "user_stories" not in keys  # not prose
    assert result["proposals"] == len(keys)
    assert "Aktivität: Bestellen" in ai.requests[0].map_outline
    assert "Annahme: X" in ai.requests[0].statements
    async with db.session() as session:
        run = (await session.scalars(select(GenerationRunEntity))).one()
        assert (run.model, run.prompt_version) == ("fake", "chapter_v1")


async def test_explicit_keys_may_rework_a_written_chapter_but_not_a_protected_one(
    db,
) -> None:
    service = await _prepare(db)
    await MapEditor(db.session, 1, "Anna").add_activity(0, "Bestellen")
    await service.save(
        "laufzeit", 1, ProseContent(blocks=[Paragraph(runs=[Run(text="Hand")])])
    )

"""Tab "Kapitel": chapter list, editor, history and proposals."""

from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.list_view import empty_list, inspector, inspector_section
from reflex.vars import ObjectVar

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.review_panel import calc_section, findings_section
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.chapter_state import (
    SHORTEN,
    TECHNICAL,
    ChapterState,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.review_state import ReviewState

Row = ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]

LIST_TITLE = "Kapitel"
DRAFT_ALL = "Fehlende Kapitel vorschlagen"
NEEDS_REVIEW = "Bitte prüfen"
BLOCKED = "Blocker"
FINDINGS = "Befunde"
PROPOSAL_BADGE = "Vorschlag"
PROTECTED_LABEL = "Kapitel schützen"
PROTECTED_BADGE = "Geschützt"
HISTORY = "Verlauf"
HISTORY_CLOSE = "Verlauf schließen"
RESTORE = "Wiederherstellen"
ACCEPT = "Vorschlag übernehmen"
REJECT = "Verwerfen"
PROPOSAL_TITLE = "KI-Vorschlag"
PROPOSAL_HINT = (
    "Der Vorschlag ändert das Kapitel erst, wenn Sie ihn übernehmen. "
    "Er bestätigt keine fachliche Entscheidung."
)
AI_TITLE = "KI-Hilfe für dieses Kapitel"
SHORTEN_LABEL = "Kürzen"
TECHNICAL_LABEL = "Technischer formulieren"
FREE_PLACEHOLDER = "Eigene Anweisung, z. B. „Nenne die Annahmen zuerst“"
FREE_LABEL = "Vorschlag anfordern"
GUIDE_TITLE = "Leitfrage"
RULES_TITLE = "Regeln der Vorlage"
WORKING_LABEL = "Die KI arbeitet …"
POLL_MS = 3000
EMPTY = "Die Kapitel entstehen, sobald das Angebot geöffnet ist."
DIFF_COLORS = {"added": theme.POSITIVE, "removed": theme.NEGATIVE}


def _list_row(chapter: Row) -> rx.Component:
    active = ChapterState.active_key == chapter["key"].to(str)
    return mn.group(
        mn.text(
            chapter["title"].to(str),
            fz="13px",
            fw=rx.cond(active, 650, 450),
            style={"flex": "1 1 auto", "minWidth": "0"},
        ),
        rx.cond(
            ReviewState.blocker_keys.contains(chapter["key"].to(str)),
            mn.badge(BLOCKED, color="red", variant="light", size="xs"),
            rx.cond(
                ReviewState.other_keys.contains(chapter["key"].to(str)),
                mn.badge(FINDINGS, color="yellow", variant="light", size="xs"),
            ),
        ),
        rx.cond(
            chapter["needs_review"].to(bool),
            mn.badge(NEEDS_REVIEW, color="yellow", variant="light", size="xs"),
        ),
        rx.cond(
            chapter["proposal"].to(bool),
            mn.badge(PROPOSAL_BADGE, color="blue", variant="light", size="xs"),
        ),
        rx.cond(
            chapter["protected"].to(bool),
            mn.badge(PROTECTED_BADGE, color="gray", variant="outline", size="xs"),
        ),
        gap=6,
        wrap="nowrap",
        px=10,
        py=8,
        on_click=ChapterState.select_chapter(chapter["key"].to(str)),
        style={
            "cursor": "pointer",
            "borderRadius": "8px",
            "background": rx.cond(active, theme.ACCENT_SOFT, "transparent"),
            "paddingLeft": rx.cond(chapter["level"].to(int) > 1, "22px", "10px"),
        },
    )


def _chapter_list() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.text(LIST_TITLE, fz="12px", fw=600, c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),

"""Open the workshop workspace of an offer, creating it on first use."""

from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import WorkspaceEntity
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.template_package import DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_KEY
from alloq_offer.workshop.repositories import workspace_repo
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.chapters import create_chapters
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.templates import latest_template

NO_WORKSPACE = "Zu diesem Angebot gibt es noch keine Werkstatt."


async def open_workspace(
    session: AsyncSession,
    offer_id: int,
    user: str,
    template_key: str = DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_KEY,
) -> WorkspaceEntity:
    """The workspace of ``offer_id``; a new one binds the latest template version.

    The new offer copies the outline of that version into its own chapters, so a
    later template change never alters it (spec 6.1).
    """
    existing = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
    if existing is not None:
        return existing
    template = await latest_template(session, template_key)
    workspace = WorkspaceEntity(
        offer_id=offer_id,
        template_key=template.key,
        template_version=template.version,
        created_by=user,
    )
    try:
        async with session.begin_nested():
            session.add(workspace)
            await session.flush()
            await create_chapters(session, offer_id, template, map_revision=0)
    except IntegrityError:
        # A second tab created the workspace first.
        found = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
        if found is None:
            raise
        return found
    return workspace

git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
feat(offer): store templates, chapter blocks and prompts in the database

Phase 1 of the plan "Angebot: Kapitel und Vorlagen".

- New tables offer_chapter_blocks, offer_templates, offer_template_chapters,
  offer_template_versions and offer_prompts (one active version per name).
- offer_chapters gets its own outline: position, title, chapter_type, level,
  required, block_key, settings and removed_at.
- Hand-written migration d1e2f3a4b5c6 seeds the quo_v1 blocks, template,
  published version 1 and the five prompts as version 1, stores the Word
  layout as a blob and backfills existing chapters. Existing workspaces keep
  template_version "quo_v1.0", which means version 1.
- On PostgreSQL the desktop role may no longer update or delete published
  versions or delete prompt versions.

Deviations from the plan:
- The Word layout is 800 KB, so the migration reads it from
  alembic/seed/quo_v1_layout.docx instead of holding it as a literal.
- The seeded layout is cleaned: reviewer comments, people, document labels
  and author names are removed (they leaked into every export before).
- The YAML files and prompt files are deleted in phase 2, where the code
  stops reading them; until then the package keeps its layout copy.
- The chapter prompt gets one rule for <kapitelanweisung> and required info,
  the map additions prompt now treats <map> and <briefing> as data too.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log -1 --oneline; git status --short

"""Template packages: published versions from the database and the Word layout."""

import io
import zipfile

import pytest
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.template_package import (
    CHAPTER_ANCHOR,
    NO_ANCHOR,
    ChapterDef,
    TemplateError,
    TemplatePackage,
    check_layout,
    clean_layout,
    frame_headings,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.services import templates
from alloq_offer.workshop.template_entities import OfferTemplateVersionEntity
from docx import Document
from pydantic import ValidationError
from sqlalchemy import select


def _docx(*lines: str) -> bytes:
    document = Document()
    for line in lines:
        document.add_paragraph(line)
    out = io.BytesIO()
    document.save(out)
    return out.getvalue()


def test_seeded_package_has_every_chapter_type(quo_v1: TemplatePackage) -> None:
    keys = [c.key for c in quo_v1.chapters]
    assert keys[0] == "management_summary"
    assert {c.chapter_type for c in quo_v1.chapters} == {
        "prose",
        "table",
        "stories",
        "calc",
    }
    assert quo_v1.chapters[0].settings().required_info == [
        "Ziel des Kunden",
        "Angebotene Lösung",
        "Umfang",
    ]


def test_chapter_start_content_matches_its_type(quo_v1: TemplatePackage) -> None:
    for chapter in quo_v1.chapters:
        assert chapter.content().chapter_type == chapter.chapter_type
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        ChapterDef(
            key="x",
            title="X",
            chapter_type="prose",
            default_content={"chapter_type": "table", "columns": ["A"]},
        )


def test_layout_has_single_anchor_and_no_customer_data(
    quo_v1: TemplatePackage,
) -> None:
    quo_v1.check_layout()
    text = "\n".join(p.text for p in check_layout(quo_v1.layout_bytes).paragraphs)
    assert text.count(CHAPTER_ANCHOR) == 1
    assert "Treysta" not in text.title()


def test_seeded_frame_matches_the_layout(quo_v1: TemplatePackage) -> None:
    assert frame_headings(quo_v1.layout_bytes) == (
        quo_v1.frame_before,
        quo_v1.frame_after,
    )


def test_duplicate_chapter_keys_rejected(quo_v1: TemplatePackage) -> None:
    chapter = quo_v1.chapters[0].model_dump()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match="eindeutig"):
        TemplatePackage(
            key="x", version="1", chapters=[chapter, chapter], layout_bytes=b""
        )


def test_layout_without_anchor_or_not_word_is_rejected() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(TemplateError, match="Anker"):
        TemplatePackage(
            key="x", version="1", chapters=[], layout_bytes=_docx("Text")
        ).check_layout()
    with pytest.raises(TemplateError, match="Word"):
        check_layout(b"kein Word")
    assert NO_ANCHOR.endswith(f"{CHAPTER_ANCHOR}.")


def test_frame_headings_split_at_the_anchor() -> None:
    document = Document()
    document.add_heading("Vorne", 1)
    document.add_paragraph("Fließtext")
    document.add_paragraph(CHAPTER_ANCHOR)
    document.add_heading("Hinten", 1)
    out = io.BytesIO()
    document.save(out)
    assert frame_headings(out.getvalue()) == (["Vorne"], ["Hinten"])


def test_clean_layout_drops_author_and_keeps_the_anchor(
    quo_v1: TemplatePackage,
) -> None:
    document = Document(io.BytesIO(_docx(CHAPTER_ANCHOR)))
    document.core_properties.author = "Erika Muster"
    out = io.BytesIO()
    document.save(out)
    cleaned = clean_layout(out.getvalue())
    assert Document(io.BytesIO(cleaned)).core_properties.author == ""
    check_layout(cleaned)
    names = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(clean_layout(quo_v1.layout_bytes))).namelist()
    assert not [n for n in names if "comments" in n or "people" in n]


def test_version_number_maps_legacy_texts() -> None:
    assert templates.version_number("quo_v1.0") == 1
    assert templates.version_number("3") == 3
    with pytest.raises(TemplateError, match=templates.UNKNOWN_VERSION):
        templates.version_number("quo_v9")


async def test_load_by_version_caches_and_rejects_unknown(db) -> None:
    async with db.session() as session:
        legacy = await templates.load_template(session, "quo_v1", "quo_v1.0")
        latest = await templates.latest_template(session, "quo_v1")
        assert legacy is latest
        assert legacy.version == "1"
        assert legacy.frame_after[-1] == "Unterschriften"
        with pytest.raises(TemplateError, match=templates.UNKNOWN_VERSION):
            await templates.load_template(session, "quo_v1", 2)
        with pytest.raises(TemplateError, match=templates.NO_VERSION):
            await templates.latest_template(session, "gibt_es_nicht")
        # Versions never change, so a later read is served from the cache.
        row = await session.scalar(select(OfferTemplateVersionEntity))
        assert row is not None
        row.payload = {"chapters": []}
    async with db.session() as session:
        cached = await templates.load_template(session, "quo_v1", 1)
    assert cached is legacy

    async with db.session() as session:

async def test_run_checks_stores_findings_and_keeps_decisions(db) -> None:
    await _workspace(db)
    async with db.session() as session:
        session.add(
            StatementEntity(
                offer_id=1, type=StatementType.REQUIREMENT, text="Schneller"
            )
        )
    count = await findings.run_checks(db.session, 1)
    assert count >= 3
    rows = await findings.list_findings(db.session, 1)
    assert rows[0]["severity"] == FindingSeverity.BLOCKER
    assert {r["rule"] for r in rows} >= {
        "required_chapter_empty",
        "commercials_unconfirmed",
    }
    note = next(r for r in rows if r["severity"] != FindingSeverity.BLOCKER)
    await findings.decide(
        db.session,
        1,
        note["id"],
        FindingDecision.ACCEPTED,
        reason="Bewusst so",
        user="Anna",
        now=NOW,
    )
    await findings.run_checks(db.session, 1)
    kept = next(
        r for r in await findings.list_findings(db.session, 1) if r["id"] == note["id"]
    )
    assert (kept["decision"], kept["reason"]) == ("akzeptiert", "Bewusst so")
    assert len(await _all(db)) == len(rows)

"""A10: nobody without the offer editor role gets workshop data or actions."""

import importlib
import inspect
import pkgutil
from collections.abc import Callable
from types import ModuleType
from typing import Any
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock

import alloq_offer.workshop.states as states_package
import pytest
import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons.access import _NOT_AUTHORIZED_MSG, ACCESS_LEVEL_ATTR

from appkit_user.authentication.states import LoginState


def _workshop_states() -> list[type[rx.State]]:
    found: dict[str, type[rx.State]] = {}
    for info in pkgutil.iter_modules(states_package.__path__):
        module: ModuleType = importlib.import_module(
            f"{states_package.__name__}.{info.name}"
        )
        for _name, cls in inspect.getmembers(module, inspect.isclass):
            if (
                issubclass(cls, rx.State)
                and cls.__module__ == module.__name__
                and cls is not rx.State
            ):
                found[cls.__qualname__] = cls
    return list(found.values())


def _args(fn: Callable[..., Any]) -> list[Any]:
    values: list[Any] = []
    for parameter in list(inspect.signature(fn).parameters.values())[1:]:
        annotation = parameter.annotation
        if annotation is bool:
            values.append(True)
        elif annotation is int:
            values.append(1)
        elif annotation is str:
            values.append("x")
        elif annotation is dict or str(annotation).startswith("dict"):
            values.append({})
        else:
            values.append([])
    return values


def _guarded_handlers() -> list[tuple[type[rx.State], str, Callable[..., Any]]]:
    return [
        (state, name, handler.fn)
        for state in _workshop_states()
        for name, handler in state.event_handlers.items()
        if getattr(handler.fn, ACCESS_LEVEL_ATTR, None) == "offer_editor"
    ]


def _state_for(cls: type[rx.State], roles: list[str], *, anonymous: bool) -> Any:
    state = cls(_reflex_internal_init=True)  # ty: ignore[unknown-argument]
    user = None if anonymous else MagicMock(is_admin=False, user_id=7, roles=roles)

    async def _user() -> Any:
        return user

    login = MagicMock()
    type(login).authenticated_user = property(lambda _self: _user())
    login.redir = AsyncMock(return_value="redirect")

    async def _get_state(requested: type) -> Any:
        if requested is LoginState:
            return login
        raise AssertionError("A denied call must not read further state")

    object.__setattr__(state, "get_state", _get_state)
    return state


async def _call(state: Any, fn: Callable[..., Any]) -> list[Any]:
    result = fn(state, *_args(fn))
    if hasattr(result, "__aiter__"):
        return [item async for item in result]
    return [await result]


def test_the_workshop_has_guarded_handlers() -> None:
    names = {f"{s.__name__}.{n}" for s, n, _ in _guarded_handlers()}
    assert {
        "ExportState.download_export",
        "WorkshopState.load_workshop",
        "ChapterState.load_chapters",
        "SourcesState.revoke_source",
        "ReviewState.accept_finding",
    } <= names
    assert len(names) > 40


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("state", "name", "fn"),
    _guarded_handlers(),
    ids=lambda value: getattr(value, "__name__", None),
)
async def test_other_roles_are_denied_before_any_data_is_touched(
    state: type[rx.State], name: str, fn: Callable[..., Any]
) -> None:
    for roles in (["employee"], ["project_manager"], ["admin"]):
        instance = _state_for(state, roles, anonymous=False)
        outcome = await _call(instance, fn)
        assert len(outcome) == 1
        assert _NOT_AUTHORIZED_MSG in str(outcome[0])


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("state", "name", "fn"),
    _guarded_handlers(),
    ids=lambda value: getattr(value, "__name__", None),
)
async def test_anonymous_callers_are_sent_to_login(
    state: type[rx.State], name: str, fn: Callable[..., Any]
) -> None:
    instance = _state_for(state, [], anonymous=True)
    assert await _call(instance, fn) == ["redirect"]

"""Outline of an offer: add, remove, restore, move, rename and number chapters."""

import pytest
from alloq_offer.entities import OfferEntity
from alloq_offer.workshop.content.schema import Paragraph, ProseContent, Run
from alloq_offer.workshop.services import outline
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.chapters import ChapterError, ChapterService
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.outline import (
    OutlineService,
    outline_numbers,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.workspace import open_workspace
from alloq_offer.workshop.template_entities import ChapterBlockEntity


async def _outline(db) -> OutlineService:  # noqa: ANN001
    async with db.session() as session:
        await open_workspace(session, 1, "Anna")
    return OutlineService(db.session, 1, "Anna")


async def _keys(db) -> list[str]:  # noqa: ANN001
    return [c["key"] for c in await ChapterService(db.session, 1, "Anna").open()]


async def _block(db, key: str = "datenschutz", active: bool = True) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    async with db.session() as session:
        session.add(
            ChapterBlockEntity(
                key=key,
                title="Datenschutz",
                chapter_type="prose",
                level=2,
                default_content={
                    "chapter_type": "prose",
                    "blocks": [
                        {"type": "paragraph", "runs": [{"text": "Wir schützen."}]}
                    ],
                },
                guiding_question="Wie schützen wir Daten?",
                content_rules=["Keine Zusagen."],
                prompt_text="Nenne die DSGVO.",
                required_info=["Speicherort"],
                checks=[],
                active=active,
            )
        )


def test_numbers_follow_position_and_level() -> None:
    assert outline_numbers([1, 1, 2, 2, 1]) == ["1", "2", "2.1", "2.2", "3"]
    assert outline_numbers([2, 1, 2]) == ["1.1", "2", "2.1"]
    assert outline_numbers([]) == []


async def test_add_library_block_after_a_chapter(db) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    service = await _outline(db)
    await _block(db)
    library = await service.library()
    assert [b["key"] for b in library] == ["datenschutz"]
    key = await service.add_chapter("management_summary", block_key="datenschutz")
    assert key.startswith(outline.NEW_KEY_PREFIX)
    assert len(key) == len(outline.NEW_KEY_PREFIX) + 8
    keys = await _keys(db)
    assert keys[:2] == ["management_summary", key]
    views = await ChapterService(db.session, 1, "Anna").open()
    added = views[1]
    assert (added["title"], added["level"], added["required"]) == (
        "Datenschutz",
        2,
        False,
    )
    assert added["guiding_question"] == "Wie schützen wir Daten?"
    loaded = await ChapterService(db.session, 1, "Anna").load(key)
    assert loaded["content"]["blocks"][0]["runs"][0]["text"] == "Wir schützen."
    assert loaded["revision"] == 1
    assert await service.library() == []


async def test_add_blank_chapter_of_each_type(db) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    service = await _outline(db)
    for chapter_type in ("prose", "table", "stories", "calc"):
        key = await service.add_chapter(
            None, chapter_type=chapter_type, title=f"Neu {chapter_type}"
        )
        loaded = await ChapterService(db.session, 1, "Anna").load(key)
        assert loaded["content"]["chapter_type"] == chapter_type
    keys = await _keys(db)
    assert len(keys) == 15
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match=outline.TITLE_NEEDED):
        await service.add_chapter(None, chapter_type="prose", title="  ")
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match=outline.UNKNOWN_TYPE):
        await service.add_chapter(None, chapter_type="bild", title="Bild")


async def test_add_refuses_unknown_inactive_or_used_block(db) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    service = await _outline(db)
    await _block(db, "alt", active=False)
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match=outline.NO_BLOCK):
        await service.add_chapter(None, block_key="alt")
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match=outline.NO_BLOCK):
        await service.add_chapter(None, block_key="gibt_es_nicht")
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match=outline.BLOCK_IN_USE):
        await service.add_chapter(None, block_key="laufzeit")
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match="Kapitel gibt es nicht"):
        await service.add_chapter("gibt_es_nicht", chapter_type="prose", title="X")


async def test_required_chapters_cannot_be_removed(db) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    service = await _outline(db)
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match=outline.REQUIRED):
        await service.remove_chapter("management_summary")


async def test_remove_and_restore_keep_revisions(db) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    service = await _outline(db)
    chapters = ChapterService(db.session, 1, "Anna")
    text = ProseContent(blocks=[Paragraph(runs=[Run(text="Annahme")])])
    await chapters.save("annahmen_risiken", 1, text)
    await service.remove_chapter("annahmen_risiken")
    assert "annahmen_risiken" not in await _keys(db)
    assert await service.removed() == [
        {"key": "annahmen_risiken", "title": "Annahmen und Risiken"}
    ]
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match="Kapitel gibt es nicht"):
        await chapters.load("annahmen_risiken")
    await service.restore_chapter("annahmen_risiken")
    assert (await _keys(db))[-1] == "annahmen_risiken"
    assert await service.removed() == []
    loaded = await chapters.load("annahmen_risiken")
    assert (loaded["revision"], loaded["content"]["blocks"][0]["runs"][0]["text"]) == (
        2,
        "Annahme",
    )
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match=outline.NOT_REMOVED):
        await service.restore_chapter("annahmen_risiken")


async def test_move_keeps_positions_dense(db) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    service = await _outline(db)
    before = await _keys(db)
    await service.move_chapter("verguetung", 0)
    after = await _keys(db)
    assert after[0] == "verguetung"
    assert sorted(after) == sorted(before)
    await service.move_chapter("verguetung", 99)
    assert (await _keys(db))[-1] == "verguetung"
    await service.remove_chapter("leistungen")
    views = await ChapterService(db.session, 1, "Anna").open()
    assert [v["position"] for v in views] == list(range(len(views)))
    assert views[0]["number"] == "1"


async def test_rename_and_level(db) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    service = await _outline(db)
    await service.rename_chapter("loesung", "  Unsere Lösung  ")
    await service.set_level("loesung", 1)
    views = {v["key"]: v for v in await ChapterService(db.session, 1, "Anna").open()}
    assert (views["loesung"]["title"], views["loesung"]["level"]) == (
        "Unsere Lösung",
        1,
    )
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match=outline.TITLE_NEEDED):
        await service.rename_chapter("loesung", "")
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match=outline.BAD_LEVEL):
        await service.set_level("loesung", 3)


async def test_protected_chapters_and_archived_offers_are_locked(db) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    service = await _outline(db)
    await ChapterService(db.session, 1, "Anna").set_protected("leistungen", True)
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match="geschützt"):
        await service.remove_chapter("leistungen")
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match="geschützt"):
        await service.rename_chapter("leistungen", "Neu")
    async with db.session() as session:
        offer = await session.get(OfferEntity, 1)
        assert offer is not None
        offer.archived = True
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match=outline.ARCHIVED):
        await service.move_chapter("laufzeit", 0)
    with pytest.raises(ChapterError, match=outline.ARCHIVED):
        await service.add_chapter(None, chapter_type="prose", title="X")

"""The outline of an offer: add, remove, restore, move, rename and re-level chapters.

The fixed frame of the Word layout is not part of the outline, so it can never
move. Required chapters can move but not go; removed chapters keep their
revisions, findings and proposals and can come back.
"""

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from alloq_offer.entities import OfferEntity
from alloq_offer.repository import german_sort_key
from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import ChapterEntity, WorkspaceEntity
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.template_package import ChapterDef
from alloq_offer.workshop.repositories import workspace_repo
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.chapters import (
    NOT_FOUND,
    PROTECTED,
    ChapterError,
    add_chapters,
    find_chapter,
    live_chapters,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.template_entities import ChapterBlockEntity

NEW_KEY_PREFIX = "custom_"
MAX_TITLE = 255
REQUIRED = "Pflichtkapitel können nicht entfernt werden."
NO_BLOCK = "Diesen Kapitelbaustein gibt es nicht."
BLOCK_IN_USE = "Dieser Baustein ist schon Teil des Angebots."
TITLE_NEEDED = "Bitte geben Sie eine Überschrift mit höchstens 255 Zeichen an."
UNKNOWN_TYPE = "Diesen Kapiteltyp gibt es nicht."
BAD_LEVEL = "Ein Kapitel hat die Ebene 1 oder 2."
ARCHIVED = "Das Angebot ist archiviert und kann nicht mehr geändert werden."
NOT_REMOVED = "Das Kapitel ist nicht entfernt."
# The start content of a blank chapter per type.
BLANK_CONTENT: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    "prose": {},
    "table": {"columns": ["Punkt", "Beschreibung"]},
    "stories": {},
    "calc": {},
}
LEVELS = (1, 2)


def _title(text: str) -> str:
    title = text.strip()
    if not title or len(title) > MAX_TITLE:
        raise ChapterError(TITLE_NEEDED)
    return title


def _renumber(chapters: list[ChapterEntity]) -> None:
    for position, chapter in enumerate(chapters):
        chapter.position = position


def _editable(chapter: ChapterEntity) -> ChapterEntity:
    if chapter.protected:
        raise ChapterError(PROTECTED)
    return chapter


class OutlineService:
    """Outline changes of one offer; each serialises on the workspace row."""

    def __init__(self, sessions: SessionFactory, offer_id: int, user: str) -> None:
        self._sessions = sessions
        self._offer_id = offer_id
        self._user = user

    async def _workspace(self, session: AsyncSession) -> WorkspaceEntity:
        workspace = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, self._offer_id)
        offer = await session.get(OfferEntity, self._offer_id)
        if workspace is None or offer is None:
            raise ChapterError(NOT_FOUND)
        if offer.archived:
            raise ChapterError(ARCHIVED)
        await session.refresh(workspace, with_for_update=True)
        return workspace

    async def _chapter(self, session: AsyncSession, key: str) -> ChapterEntity:
        await self._workspace(session)
        return _editable(await find_chapter(session, self._offer_id, key, lock=True))

    async def library(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Active blocks the offer does not use yet, by title."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            used = {c.block_key for c in await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id)}
            blocks = (
                await session.scalars(
                    select(ChapterBlockEntity).where(ChapterBlockEntity.active)
                )
            ).all()
        return [
            {
                "key": block.key,
                "title": block.title,
                "type": block.chapter_type,
                "description": block.guiding_question,
            }
            for block in sorted(blocks, key=lambda b: german_sort_key(b.title))
            if block.key not in used
        ]

    async def removed(self) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        """Removed chapters, last removed first."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            rows = (
                await session.scalars(
                    select(ChapterEntity)
                    .where(
                        ChapterEntity.offer_id == self._offer_id,
                        ChapterEntity.removed_at.is_not(None),
                    )
                    .order_by(ChapterEntity.removed_at.desc(), ChapterEntity.id)
                )
            ).all()
        return [{"key": row.chapter_key, "title": row.title} for row in rows]

    async def _definition(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        key: str,
        chapters: list[ChapterEntity],
        *,
        block_key: str | None,
        chapter_type: str,
        title: str,
    ) -> ChapterDef:
        if block_key is None:
            if chapter_type not in BLANK_CONTENT:
                raise ChapterError(UNKNOWN_TYPE)
            return ChapterDef(
                key=key,
                title=_title(title),
                chapter_type=chapter_type,  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                default_content=BLANK_CONTENT[chapter_type],
            )
        block = await session.scalar(
            select(ChapterBlockEntity).where(
                ChapterBlockEntity.key == block_key, ChapterBlockEntity.active
            )
        )
        if block is None:
            raise ChapterError(NO_BLOCK)
        if any(c.block_key == block_key for c in chapters):
            raise ChapterError(BLOCK_IN_USE)
        return ChapterDef.model_validate(
            {
                **block.to_dict(),
                "key": key,
                "title": _title(title or block.title),
            }
        )

    async def add_chapter(
        self,
        after_key: str | None,
        *,
        block_key: str | None = None,
        chapter_type: str = "",
        title: str = "",
    ) -> str:
        """Insert a library block or a blank chapter after ``after_key`` (else last).

        Returns the key of the new chapter.
        """
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            workspace = await self._workspace(session)
            chapters = await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id)
            keys = [c.chapter_key for c in chapters]
            if after_key is not None and after_key not in keys:
                raise ChapterError(NOT_FOUND)
            index = keys.index(after_key) + 1 if after_key else len(chapters)
            key = f"{NEW_KEY_PREFIX}{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
            definition = await self._definition(
                session,
                key,
                chapters,
                block_key=block_key,
                chapter_type=chapter_type,
                title=title,
            )
            [chapter] = await add_chapters(
                session, self._offer_id, [(definition, block_key)], workspace.map_revision
            )
            chapters.insert(index, chapter)
            _renumber(chapters)
            return key

    async def remove_chapter(self, key: str) -> None:
        """Take a chapter out of the outline; required chapters stay."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            chapter = await self._chapter(session, key)
            if chapter.required:
                raise ChapterError(REQUIRED)
            chapter.removed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
            _renumber(await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id))

    async def restore_chapter(self, key: str) -> None:
        """Bring a removed chapter back at the end of the outline."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            await self._workspace(session)
            chapter = await session.scalar(
                select(ChapterEntity)
                .where(
                    ChapterEntity.offer_id == self._offer_id,
                    ChapterEntity.chapter_key == key,
                )
                .with_for_update()
            )
            if chapter is None:
                raise ChapterError(NOT_FOUND)
            if chapter.removed_at is None:
                raise ChapterError(NOT_REMOVED)
            chapters = await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id)
            chapter.removed_at = None
            _renumber([*chapters, chapter])

    async def move_chapter(self, key: str, new_index: int) -> None:
        """Put a chapter at ``new_index`` of the outline; positions stay dense."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            chapter = await self._chapter(session, key)
            chapters = [
                c
                for c in await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id)
                if c.id != chapter.id
            ]
            chapters.insert(max(0, min(new_index, len(chapters))), chapter)
            _renumber(chapters)

    async def rename_chapter(self, key: str, title: str) -> None:
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            chapter = await self._chapter(session, key)
            chapter.title = _title(title)

    async def set_level(self, key: str, level: int) -> None:
        if level not in LEVELS:
            raise ChapterError(BAD_LEVEL)
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            chapter = await self._chapter(session, key)
            chapter.level = level

# Offer workshop template (QUO)

The workshop fills the customer template `Templates/QUO-33441-N7R0Z4_Preisindikation MVP Referenzdatenbank Treystar .docx`.
`scripts/inventory_docx.py` prints its structure; `scripts/build_quo_layout.py` turns it into the package layout.

## What is fixed and what is generated

| Part | Source in the QUO file | In the package |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cover (title, customer, date, quote id) | paragraphs 0 to 25 | `layout.docx` with `{{ project_title }}`, `{{ customer_name }}`, `{{ customer_street }}`, `{{ customer_city }}`, `{{ customer_short }}`, `{{ offer_date }}`, `{{ quote_id }}` |
| Legal notice, supplier address | cover | fixed text |
| Table of contents | missing in the QUO file | TOC field `1-3`, updated when Word opens the file |
| Chapters Management Summary to Consumption | Heading 1 to 3 | removed from the layout, rendered from typed chapters at the anchor `[[KAPITEL]]` |
| Rechtliche Bestimmungen, Bindefrist (`{{ validity_date }}`), Sonstiges, Anlagen, Unterschriften | tail | fixed text; signature placeholders (`$$_PRT_..._$$`) stay untouched |

Customer data is removed from the layout. There is no story map chapter: the document shows written stories only.

## Chapters (`chapters.yaml`)

| Key | Level | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `management_summary` | 1 | prose | yes |
| `leistungen` | 1 | prose | no |
| `user_stories` | 2 | stories (all live stories, grouped by activity) | yes |
| `loesung` | 2 | prose | yes |
Deps: `uv add --package alloq-offer pypdf python-pptx` (+ `pydantic-ai-slim[openai]` if the transcriber uses the openai client in this phase).

## Phase 3 — AI port, story map generation and the one-click draft pipeline (spec §8, §9)

1. `ai/` port: `OfferAi` protocol with methods `propose_map`, `propose_briefing`, `propose_chapter`, `review`, each returning validated Pydantic output; implementation with pydantic-ai agents on Azure OpenAI deployments from config; prompt texts in versioned files (`ai/prompts/*.md`, version string stored with every run). Source text is passed as clearly delimited **data**; system prompt states that instructions inside sources must be ignored (§15). Call budget and timeout per job.
2. Output schemas: `ProposedMap` (vision, roles, activities → tasks → stories {title, role, goal, benefit, origin `Kunde|Vorschlag`, source_refs [block ids], scope always `offen`}, slices, skeleton suggestions, open questions, conflicts) and `ProposedBriefing` (statements per §8.1 type: Kundenanforderung, Belegter Sachverhalt, Lösungsvorschlag, Annahme, Offener Punkt/Konflikt; with source refs).
3. Entities + migration: `offer_activities`, `offer_tasks`, `offer_stories` (key unique per offer from `story_seq`, e.g. `US-07`, title, role, goal, benefit, scope `offen|angeboten|option|ausgeschlossen`, origin `Kunde|Vorschlag|Nutzer`, slice_id, skeleton, priority, source_refs JSON, split_from_id, archived_at), `offer_slices`, `offer_statements` (type, text, status, source_refs, needs_recheck, confirmed_by/at), `offer_map_revisions` (offer_id, revision, immutable snapshot JSON, created_by, created_at), `offer_generation_runs` (job_id, kind, model, prompt_version, input revisions, status).
4. Pure services: `story_validation` (exactly one sentence "Als … möchte ich …, um …"; reject Given/When/Then, "Akzeptanzkriterien", bullet checklists — A20), `apply_proposed_map` (app assigns keys; AI never reuses or reinterprets existing keys; new AI stories never get scope `angeboten` — A25), `snapshot_map` (builds revision JSON).
5. Job kind `initial_draft` as an **end-to-end pipeline** of named stages, each stage persisted before the next starts so a failure resumes from the last finished stage: `extract` → `map` (save map revision 1) → `briefing` → `scope_proposal` (mark the walking skeleton as proposed scope; stories stay `offen`) → `chapters` → `checks` → `word_draft`. This phase implements the first four stages; Phases 5, 6 and 7 register `chapters`, `checks` and `word_draft` in the same pipeline (stage registry, so a missing stage is skipped and reported, not faked). Progress per stage is visible in the UI ("Entwurf wird erstellt …" list). Auto-draft: when the workspace setting is on and a source becomes usable, enqueue `initial_draft` (or, if a draft exists, a map-update **proposal**, never an overwrite).

The workshop fills the customer template `Templates/QUO-33441-N7R0Z4_Preisindikation MVP Referenzdatenbank Treystar .docx`.

+The template lives in the database: the migration `2026_10_31_offer_templates.py` seeds template `quo_v1` as published version 1, with its chapter blocks and the layout from `alembic/seed/quo_v1_layout.docx` as a blob.
## What is fixed and what is generated
| Part | Source in the QUO file | In the package |

-| Cover (title, customer, date, quote id) | paragraphs 0 to 25 | `layout.docx` with `{{ project_title }}`, `{{ customer_name }}`, `{{ customer_street }}`, `{{ customer_city }}`, `{{ customer_short }}`, `{{ offer_date }}`, `{{ quote_id }}` |

+| Cover (title, customer, date, quote id) | paragraphs 0 to 25 | the layout with `{{ project_title }}`, `{{ customer_name }}`, `{{ customer_street }}`, `{{ customer_city }}`, `{{ customer_short }}`, `{{ offer_date }}`, `{{ quote_id }}` |
| Legal notice, supplier address | cover | fixed text |
| Table of contents | missing in the QUO file | TOC field `1-3`, updated when Word opens the file |
| Chapters Management Summary to Consumption | Heading 1 to 3 | removed from the layout, rendered from typed chapters at the anchor `[[KAPITEL]]` |
| Rechtliche Bestimmungen, Bindefrist (`{{ validity_date }}`), Sonstiges, Anlagen, Unterschriften | tail | fixed text; signature placeholders (`$$_PRT_..._$$`) stay untouched |
-Customer data is removed from the layout. There is no story map chapter: the document shows written stories only.
+Customer data, reviewer comments, people, labels and author names are removed from the layout. There is no story map chapter: the document shows written stories only.
## Phase 3 — AI port, story map generation and the one-click draft pipeline (spec §8, §9)

-1. `ai/` port: `OfferAi` protocol with methods `propose_map`, `propose_briefing`, `propose_chapter`, `review`, each returning validated Pydantic output; implementation with pydantic-ai agents on Azure OpenAI deployments from config; prompt texts in versioned files (`ai/prompts/*.md`, version string stored with every run). Source text is passed as clearly delimited **data**; system prompt states that instructions inside sources must be ignored (§15). Call budget and timeout per job.

+1. `ai/` port: `OfferAi` protocol with methods `propose_map`, `propose_briefing`, `propose_chapter`, `review`, each returning validated Pydantic output; implementation with pydantic-ai agents on Azure OpenAI deployments from config; prompt texts versioned in the database (`offer_prompts`, one active version per name; the run stores `name@version`). Source text is passed as clearly delimited **data**; system prompt states that instructions inside sources must be ignored (§15). Call budget and timeout per job.

2. Output schemas: `ProposedMap` (vision, roles, activities → tasks → stories {title, role, goal, benefit, origin `Kunde|Vorschlag`, source_refs [block ids], scope always `offen`}, slices, skeleton suggestions, open questions, conflicts) and `ProposedBriefing` (statements per §8.1 type: Kundenanforderung, Belegter Sachverhalt, Lösungsvorschlag, Annahme, Offener Punkt/Konflikt; with source refs).

3. Entities + migration: `offer_activities`, `offer_tasks`, `offer_stories` (key unique per offer from `story_seq`, e.g. `US-07`, title, role, goal, benefit, scope `offen|angeboten|option|ausgeschlossen`, origin `Kunde|Vorschlag|Nutzer`, slice_id, skeleton, priority, source_refs JSON, split_from_id, archived_at), `offer_slices`, `offer_statements` (type, text, status, source_refs, needs_recheck, confirmed_by/at), `offer_map_revisions` (offer_id, revision, immutable snapshot JSON, created_by, created_at), `offer_generation_runs` (job_id, kind, model, prompt_version, input revisions, status).

4. Pure services: `story_validation` (exactly one sentence "Als … möchte ich …, um …"; reject Given/When/Then, "Akzeptanzkriterien", bullet checklists — A20), `apply_proposed_map` (app assigns keys; AI never reuses or reinterprets existing keys; new AI stories never get scope `angeboten` — A25), `snapshot_map` (builds revision JSON).

feat(offer): read templates, chapter settings and prompts from the database

Phase 2 of the plan "Angebot: Kapitel und Vorlagen".

- services/templates.py loads a published template version into the
  TemplatePackage (layout from its blob, checked once) and caches it by
  version row; legacy workspaces with "quo_v1.0" mean version 1.
- open_workspace binds the latest version of quo_v1 and copies its outline
  into the offer's own chapters; the subtitle shows "Version n".
- Findings, the draft job, the export snapshot, commercials and draft
  requests read the offer's chapters (order, title, level, type, settings)
  instead of the template. Only workspace creation and the export job still
  load a template version; an export request is blocked when it is missing.
- Per-chapter checks (contains_all_stories, no_acceptance_criteria,
  commercials_confirmed) decide where findings land; no_acceptance_criteria
  also reads chapter text and story descriptions.
- The chapter request carries the chapter's required info and prompt text
  (<kapitelanweisung>).
- PydanticOfferAi reads the active prompt once per job, puts a fixed data-tag
  guard per prompt in front of it and records "name@version". A missing
  prompt fails the job with a readable German message.
- clean_layout() strips comments, people, labels, linked files, tracked
  changes and author data from a Word layout (used by the admin upload).
- Prompt data is escaped: brackets in text, also quotes and ampersands in
  attributes; source attributes and texts use the same escaping; the review
  drops whole chapters past its budget instead of cutting tags.
- YAML files, prompt files and the package layout copy are deleted; pyyaml is
  no longer a dependency of alloq-offer.

Deviations from the plan:
- "TemplateService" is a module of functions (load_template,
  latest_template, template_exists) because it holds no per-user state.
- SnapshotError is gone: a snapshot no longer needs the template; the
  export request checks the bound version instead.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

    await _prepared(db)
    export = await _request(db)
    assert export.status == ExportStatus.WORKING
    assert export.filename.endswith("-Entwurf-1.docx")
    async with db.session() as session:
        snapshot = await session.scalar(select(SnapshotEntity))
        job = await session.scalar(select(JobEntity))
    assert snapshot is not None
    assert snapshot.number == 1
    chapter = next(c for c in snapshot.content["chapters"] if c["key"] == KEY)
    assert chapter["revision"] == 2
    assert job is not None
    assert job.kind == EXPORT_JOB
    assert job.payload == {"export_id": export.id}
    # Later edits do not change the snapshot.
    await ChapterService(db.session, 1, "Anna").save(
        KEY, 2, ProseContent(blocks=[Paragraph(runs=[Run(text="Neu")])])
    )
    async with db.session() as session:
        again = await session.scalar(select(SnapshotEntity))
    assert again is not None
    assert "Fertiger Text" in str(again.content)

"""Body of the workshop page: tabs and their content."""

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.list_view import empty_list
from alloq_commons.components.toolbar import scope_bar, segmented

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.briefing_tab import briefing_tab
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.chapters_tab import chapters_tab
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.draft_tab import draft_tab
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.export_tab import export_tab
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.map_tab import map_tab
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.map_view import map_filter_row
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.map_state import MapState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.workshop_state import (
    TAB_BRIEFING,
    TAB_CHAPTERS,
    TAB_DRAFT,
    TAB_EXPORT,
    TAB_MAP,
    TABS,
    WorkshopState,
)

NOT_FOUND_TEXT = "Dieses Angebot gibt es nicht."


def workshop_tabs() -> rx.Component:
    return segmented(WorkshopState.active_tab, WorkshopState.set_tab, TABS)


def workshop_scope() -> rx.Component:
    """Filter row below the toolbar; only the story map has one."""
    return rx.cond(
        (WorkshopState.active_tab == TAB_MAP) & MapState.has_map,
        scope_bar(map_filter_row()),
    )


def workshop_body() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.box(_workshop_content(), class_name="aq-ws")


def _workshop_content() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.cond(
        WorkshopState.not_found,
        mn.box(empty_list(NOT_FOUND_TEXT), p=20),
        rx.cond(
            WorkshopState.loaded,
            rx.match(
                WorkshopState.active_tab,
                (TAB_DRAFT, draft_tab()),
                (TAB_MAP, map_tab()),
                (TAB_CHAPTERS, chapters_tab()),
                (TAB_BRIEFING, briefing_tab()),
                (TAB_EXPORT, export_tab()),
                draft_tab(),
            ),
            mn.box(mn.loader(size="sm"), p=20, c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
        ),
    )

"""Body of the workshop page: tabs and their content."""

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.list_view import empty_list
from alloq_commons.components.toolbar import scope_bar, segmented

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.briefing_tab import briefing_tab
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.chapters_tab import chapters_tab
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.draft_tab import draft_tab
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.export_tab import export_tab
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.map_tab import map_tab
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.map_view import map_filter_row
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.map_state import MapState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.workshop_state import (
    TAB_BRIEFING,
    TAB_CHAPTERS,
    TAB_DRAFT,
    TAB_EXPORT,
    TAB_MAP,
    TABS,
    WorkshopState,
)

NOT_FOUND_TEXT = "Dieses Angebot gibt es nicht."


def workshop_tabs() -> rx.Component:
    return segmented(WorkshopState.active_tab, WorkshopState.set_tab, TABS)


def workshop_scope() -> rx.Component:
    """Filter row below the toolbar; only the story map has one."""
    return rx.cond(
        (WorkshopState.active_tab == TAB_MAP) & MapState.has_map,
        scope_bar(map_filter_row()),
    )


def workshop_body() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.box(_workshop_content(), class_name="aq-ws")


def _workshop_content() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.cond(
        WorkshopState.not_found,
        mn.box(empty_list(NOT_FOUND_TEXT), p=20),
        rx.cond(
            WorkshopState.loaded,
            rx.match(
                WorkshopState.active_tab,
                (TAB_DRAFT, draft_tab()),
                (TAB_MAP, map_tab()),
                (TAB_CHAPTERS, chapters_tab()),
                (TAB_BRIEFING, briefing_tab()),
                (TAB_EXPORT, export_tab()),
                draft_tab(),
            ),
            mn.box(mn.loader(size="sm"), p=20, c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
        ),
    )

import reflex as rx
from alloq_project.states.planning_grid_state import PlanningStore

import appkit_mantine as mn

VIEW_MODES: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = [
    ("Grid", "Team", "users"),
    ("Projekte", "Projekte", "folder-kanban"),
    ("Abwesenheiten", "Abwesenheiten", "calendar-off"),
]


class _PlanningFilterRow(rx.Component):
    """Measure inline controls and reveal overflowing filters on hover."""

    library = rx.asset("planning_filter_row.jsx", shared=True).importable_path
    tag = "PlanningFilterRow"


def _ms_class(has_mehr: rx.Var) -> rx.Var:
    """CSS class for filter multi-select, adds 'has-mehr' when needed."""
    return rx.cond(has_mehr, "alloq-filter-ms has-mehr", "alloq-filter-ms")


def planning_view_switch() -> rx.Component:
    """Segmented control for the planning views, shown in the toolbar."""
    return mn.segmented_control(
        data=[
            {
                "value": value,
                "label": mn.center(
                    rx.icon(icon, size=14, stroke_width=1.8),
                    mn.text(label, fz="12.5px"),
                    gap="5px",
                ),
            }
            for value, label, icon in VIEW_MODES
        ],
        value=PlanningStore.view_mode,
        on_change=PlanningStore.set_view_mode,
        size="xs",
        radius="md",
        class_name="aq-segmented",
    )


def planning_filter_row() -> rx.Component:
    """Scope bar of the planning page: time range, filters, availability."""
    return _PlanningFilterRow.create(
        # Time range
        mn.segmented_control(
            data=["3 Monate", "6 Monate", "12 Monate"],
            value=PlanningStore.time_range,
            on_change=PlanningStore.set_time_range,
            size="xs",
            radius="md",
            class_name="aq-segmented",
        ),
        # Employee filter
        mn.multi_select(
            data=PlanningStore.employee_select_options,
            value=PlanningStore.employee_filter.to(list[str]),
            on_change=PlanningStore.set_employee_filter,
            placeholder="Mitarbeiter",
            searchable=True,
            clearable=True,
            combobox_props={"withinPortal": False},
            size="xs",
            w="11rem",
            class_name=_ms_class(PlanningStore.employee_filter.length() > 0),
            style={"--alloq-mehr": PlanningStore.employee_filter_label},
        ),
        # Project filter
        mn.multi_select(
            data=PlanningStore.project_select_options,
            value=PlanningStore.project_filter.to(list[str]),
            on_change=PlanningStore.set_project_filter,
            placeholder="Projekte",
            searchable=True,
            clearable=True,
            combobox_props={"withinPortal": False},
            size="xs",
            w="11rem",
            class_name=_ms_class(PlanningStore.project_filter.length() > 0),
            style={"--alloq-mehr": PlanningStore.project_filter_label},
        ),
        # Role filter
        mn.multi_select(
            data=PlanningStore.role_select_options,
            value=PlanningStore.role_filter.to(list[str]),
            on_change=PlanningStore.set_role_filter,
            placeholder="Rollen",
            searchable=True,
            clearable=True,
            combobox_props={"withinPortal": False},
            size="xs",
            w="11rem",
            class_name=_ms_class(PlanningStore.role_filter.length() > 0),
            style={"--alloq-mehr": PlanningStore.role_filter_label},
        ),
        mn.switch(
            label="Nur verfügbare",
            checked=PlanningStore.available_only,
            on_change=PlanningStore.set_available_only,
            color="blue",
            size="xs",
        ),
        mn.switch(
            label="Interne & Abwesenheit ausblenden",
            checked=PlanningStore.hide_internal,
            on_change=PlanningStore.set_hide_internal,
            color="blue",
            size="xs",
        ),
    )


def absence_filter_row() -> rx.Component:
    """Scope bar of the absence view: time range, people, roles and summary."""
    gantt = PlanningStore.absence_gantt
    return _PlanningFilterRow.create(
        mn.segmented_control(
            data=["3 Monate", "6 Monate", "12 Monate"],
            value=PlanningStore.time_range,
            on_change=PlanningStore.set_time_range,
            size="xs",
            radius="md",
            class_name="aq-segmented",
        ),
        mn.multi_select(
            data=PlanningStore.employee_select_options,
            value=PlanningStore.employee_filter.to(list[str]),
            on_change=PlanningStore.set_employee_filter,
            placeholder="Mitarbeiter",
            searchable=True,
            clearable=True,
            combobox_props={"withinPortal": False},
            size="xs",
            w="11rem",
            class_name=_ms_class(PlanningStore.employee_filter.length() > 0),
            style={"--alloq-mehr": PlanningStore.employee_filter_label},
        ),
        mn.multi_select(
            data=PlanningStore.role_select_options,
            value=PlanningStore.role_filter.to(list[str]),
            on_change=PlanningStore.set_role_filter,
            placeholder="Rollen",
            searchable=True,
            clearable=True,
            combobox_props={"withinPortal": False},
            size="xs",
            w="11rem",
            class_name=_ms_class(PlanningStore.role_filter.length() > 0),
            style={"--alloq-mehr": PlanningStore.role_filter_label},
        ),
        mn.switch(
            label="Ganzes Team zeigen",
            checked=PlanningStore.absence_show_all,
            on_change=PlanningStore.set_absence_show_all,
            color="blue",
            size="xs",
        ),
        rx.cond(
            gantt.bottleneck_label != "",
            mn.tooltip(
                mn.badge(
                    gantt.bottleneck_label,
                    left_section=rx.icon("triangle-alert", size=13),
                    variant="light",

"""The outline of an offer: add, remove, restore, move, rename and re-level chapters.

The fixed frame of the Word layout is not part of the outline, so it can never
move. Required chapters can move but not go; removed chapters keep their
revisions, findings and proposals and can come back. Word numbers the chapter
headings through its heading styles, so the first chapter always has level 1.
"""

import logging
import re
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from pydantic import ValidationError
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from alloq_offer.repository import german_sort_key
from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import ChapterEntity, WorkspaceEntity
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.template_package import ChapterDef
from alloq_offer.workshop.repositories import workspace_repo
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.chapters import (
    NOT_FOUND,
    ChapterError,
    ChapterService,
    add_chapters,
    ensure_editable,
    ensure_open,
    find_chapter,
    live_chapters,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.template_entities import ChapterBlockEntity

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

NEW_KEY_PREFIX = "custom_"
MAX_TITLE = 255
MAX_CHAPTERS = 100
REQUIRED = "Pflichtkapitel können nicht entfernt werden."
NO_BLOCK = "Diesen Kapitelbaustein gibt es nicht."
BLOCK_IN_USE = "Dieser Baustein ist schon Teil des Angebots."
TITLE_NEEDED = (
    "Bitte geben Sie eine Überschrift mit höchstens 255 Zeichen in einer Zeile an."
)
UNKNOWN_TYPE = "Diesen Kapiteltyp gibt es nicht."
BAD_LEVEL = "Ein Kapitel hat die Ebene 1 oder 2."
FIRST_LEVEL = "Das erste Kapitel hat immer die Ebene 1."
TOO_MANY = "Ein Angebot hat höchstens 100 Kapitel."
RESTORED = "Das Kapitel wurde wiederhergestellt. Bitte prüfen Sie den Stand."
# The start content of a blank chapter per type.
BLANK_CONTENT: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    "prose": {},
    "table": {"columns": ["Punkt", "Beschreibung"]},
    "stories": {},
    "calc": {},
}
LEVELS = (1, 2)
CONTROL_CHARACTERS = re.compile(r"[\x00-\x1f\x7f]")


def _title(text: str) -> str:
    title = text.strip()
    if not title or len(title) > MAX_TITLE or CONTROL_CHARACTERS.search(title):
        raise ChapterError(TITLE_NEEDED)
    return title


def _renumber(chapters: list[ChapterEntity]) -> None:
    """Dense positions; a chapter that moved to the top becomes level 1."""
    for position, chapter in enumerate(chapters):
        chapter.position = position
    if chapters:
        chapters[0].level = 1


class OutlineService:
    """Outline changes of one offer; each serialises on the workspace row."""

    def __init__(self, sessions: SessionFactory, offer_id: int, user: str) -> None:
        self._sessions = sessions
        self._offer_id = offer_id
        self._user = user

    async def _workspace(self, session: AsyncSession) -> WorkspaceEntity:
        workspace = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, self._offer_id)
        if workspace is None:
            raise ChapterError(NOT_FOUND)
        await session.refresh(workspace, with_for_update=True)
        await ensure_open(session, self._offer_id)
        return workspace

    async def _chapter(self, session: AsyncSession, key: str) -> ChapterEntity:
        await self._workspace(session)
        chapter = await find_chapter(session, self._offer_id, key, lock=True)
        return ensure_editable(chapter)

    async def _used_blocks(self, session: AsyncSession) -> set[str]:
        """Blocks of the offer, removed chapters included: those come back by restore."""
        keys = await session.scalars(
            select(ChapterEntity.block_key).where(
                ChapterEntity.offer_id == self._offer_id,
                ChapterEntity.block_key.is_not(None),
            )
        )
        return {key for key in keys.all() if key}

    async def library(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Active blocks the offer does not use yet, by title."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            used = await self._used_blocks(session)
            blocks = (
                await session.scalars(
                    select(ChapterBlockEntity).where(ChapterBlockEntity.active)
                )
            ).all()
        return [
            {
                "key": block.key,
                "title": block.title,
                "type": block.chapter_type,
                "description": block.guiding_question,
            }
            for block in sorted(blocks, key=lambda b: german_sort_key(b.title))
            if block.key not in used
        ]

    async def removed(self) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        """Removed chapters, last removed first."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            rows = (
                await session.scalars(
                    select(ChapterEntity)
                    .where(
                        ChapterEntity.offer_id == self._offer_id,
                        ChapterEntity.removed_at.is_not(None),
                    )
                    .order_by(ChapterEntity.removed_at.desc(), ChapterEntity.id)
                )
            ).all()
        return [{"key": row.chapter_key, "title": row.title} for row in rows]

    async def _block_definition(
        self, session: AsyncSession, key: str, block_key: str, title: str
    ) -> ChapterDef:
        block = await session.scalar(
            select(ChapterBlockEntity).where(
                ChapterBlockEntity.key == block_key, ChapterBlockEntity.active
            )
        )
        if block is None:
            raise ChapterError(NO_BLOCK)
        if block_key in await self._used_blocks(session):
            raise ChapterError(BLOCK_IN_USE)
        try:
            return ChapterDef.model_validate(
                {
                    **block.to_dict(),
                    "key": key,
                    "title": _title(title.strip() or block.title),
                }
            )
        except ValidationError as exc:
            logger.warning("Chapter block %s is invalid", block_key)
            raise ChapterError(NO_BLOCK) from exc

    @staticmethod
    def _blank_definition(key: str, chapter_type: str, title: str) -> ChapterDef:
        if chapter_type not in BLANK_CONTENT:
            raise ChapterError(UNKNOWN_TYPE)
        return ChapterDef(
            key=key,
            title=_title(title),
            chapter_type=chapter_type,  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
            default_content=BLANK_CONTENT[chapter_type],
        )

    async def add_chapter(
        self,
        after_key: str | None,
        *,
        block_key: str | None = None,
        chapter_type: str = "",
        title: str = "",
    ) -> str:
        """Insert a library block, or else a blank chapter of ``chapter_type``.

        It goes after ``after_key``, or last without one; returns the new key.
        """
        # An older offer gets its template chapters before anything is added.
        await ChapterService(self._sessions, self._offer_id, self._user).open()
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            workspace = await self._workspace(session)
            chapters = await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id)
            if len(chapters) >= MAX_CHAPTERS:
                raise ChapterError(TOO_MANY)
            keys = [c.chapter_key for c in chapters]
            if after_key is not None and after_key not in keys:
                raise ChapterError(NOT_FOUND)
            index = len(chapters) if after_key is None else keys.index(after_key) + 1
            key = f"{NEW_KEY_PREFIX}{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
            definition = (
                await self._block_definition(session, key, block_key, title)
                if block_key is not None
                else self._blank_definition(key, chapter_type, title)
            )
            [chapter] = await add_chapters(
                session,
                self._offer_id,
                [(definition, block_key)],
                workspace.map_revision,
            )
            chapters.insert(index, chapter)
            _renumber(chapters)
        logger.info("Chapter %s added to offer %s", key, self._offer_id)
        return key

    async def remove_chapter(self, key: str) -> None:
        """Take a chapter out of the outline; required chapters stay."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            chapter = await self._chapter(session, key)
            if chapter.required:
                raise ChapterError(REQUIRED)
            chapter.removed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
            _renumber(await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id))
        logger.info("Chapter %s of offer %s removed", key, self._offer_id)

    async def restore_chapter(self, key: str) -> None:
        """Bring a removed chapter back at the end of the outline.

        Its text may have missed map changes meanwhile, so a written text chapter
        asks for a new look.
        """
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            await self._workspace(session)
            chapter = await find_chapter(
                session, self._offer_id, key, lock=True, removed=True
            )
            chapters = await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id)
            if len(chapters) >= MAX_CHAPTERS:
                raise ChapterError(TOO_MANY)
            chapter.removed_at = None
            if chapter.chapter_type == "prose" and chapter.revision > 1:
                chapter.needs_review = True
                chapter.review_reason = RESTORED
            _renumber([*chapters, chapter])
        logger.info("Chapter %s of offer %s restored", key, self._offer_id)

    async def move_chapter(self, key: str, new_index: int) -> None:
        """Put a chapter at ``new_index`` of the outline; positions stay dense."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            chapter = await self._chapter(session, key)
            chapters = [
                c
                for c in await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id)
                if c.id != chapter.id
            ]
            chapters.insert(max(0, min(new_index, len(chapters))), chapter)
            _renumber(chapters)

    async def rename_chapter(self, key: str, title: str) -> None:
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            chapter = await self._chapter(session, key)
            chapter.title = _title(title)

    async def set_level(self, key: str, level: int) -> None:
        if level not in LEVELS:
            raise ChapterError(BAD_LEVEL)
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            chapter = await self._chapter(session, key)
            if level != 1 and chapter.position == 0:
                raise ChapterError(FIRST_LEVEL)
            chapter.level = level

                chapter_type=chapter_type,  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                default_content=BLANK_CONTENT[chapter_type],
            )
        block = await session.scalar(
            select(ChapterBlockEntity).where(
                ChapterBlockEntity.key == block_key, ChapterBlockEntity.active
            )
        )
        if block is None:
            raise ChapterError(NO_BLOCK)
        if any(c.block_key == block_key for c in chapters):
            raise ChapterError(BLOCK_IN_USE)
        return ChapterDef.model_validate(
            {
                **block.to_dict(),
                "key": key,
                "title": _title(title or block.title),
            }
        )

    async def add_chapter(
        self,
        after_key: str | None,
        *,
        block_key: str | None = None,
        chapter_type: str = "",
        title: str = "",
    ) -> str:
        """Insert a library block or a blank chapter after ``after_key`` (else last).

        Returns the key of the new chapter.
        """
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            workspace = await self._workspace(session)
            chapters = await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id)
            keys = [c.chapter_key for c in chapters]
            if after_key is not None and after_key not in keys:
                raise ChapterError(NOT_FOUND)
            index = keys.index(after_key) + 1 if after_key else len(chapters)
            key = f"{NEW_KEY_PREFIX}{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
            definition = await self._definition(
                session,
                key,
                chapters,
                block_key=block_key,
                chapter_type=chapter_type,
                title=title,
            )
            [chapter] = await add_chapters(
                session,
                self._offer_id,
                [(definition, block_key)],
                workspace.map_revision,
            )
            chapters.insert(index, chapter)
            _renumber(chapters)
            return key

    async def remove_chapter(self, key: str) -> None:
        """Take a chapter out of the outline; required chapters stay."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            chapter = await self._chapter(session, key)
            if chapter.required:
                raise ChapterError(REQUIRED)
            chapter.removed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
            _renumber(await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id))

    async def restore_chapter(self, key: str) -> None:
        """Bring a removed chapter back at the end of the outline."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            await self._workspace(session)
            chapter = await session.scalar(
                select(ChapterEntity)
                .where(
                    ChapterEntity.offer_id == self._offer_id,
                    ChapterEntity.chapter_key == key,
                )
                .with_for_update()
            )
            if chapter is None:
                raise ChapterError(NOT_FOUND)
            if chapter.removed_at is None:
                raise ChapterError(NOT_REMOVED)
            chapters = await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id)
            chapter.removed_at = None
            _renumber([*chapters, chapter])

    async def move_chapter(self, key: str, new_index: int) -> None:
        """Put a chapter at ``new_index`` of the outline; positions stay dense."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            chapter = await self._chapter(session, key)
            chapters = [
                c
                for c in await live_chapters(session, self._offer_id)
                if c.id != chapter.id
            ]
            chapters.insert(max(0, min(new_index, len(chapters))), chapter)
            _renumber(chapters)

    async def rename_chapter(self, key: str, title: str) -> None:
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            chapter = await self._chapter(session, key)
            chapter.title = _title(title)

    async def set_level(self, key: str, level: int) -> None:
        if level not in LEVELS:
            raise ChapterError(BAD_LEVEL)
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            chapter = await self._chapter(session, key)
            chapter.level = level

feat(offer): add, remove, restore, move and number offer chapters

Phase 3 of the plan "Angebot: Kapitel und Vorlagen".

- services/outline.py (OutlineService): add a chapter from a library block
  or a blank chapter of a type after a given chapter (key custom_<8 hex>,
  revision 1 from the block's or the type's start content), remove
  (soft delete; required chapters stay), restore at the end, move with
  dense positions, rename and set the level. Every change locks the
  workspace row; archived offers and protected chapters refuse it.
- A block is used once per offer, removed chapters included; it comes back
  by restore. A restored written text chapter asks for a new look.

from typing import Any

from alloq_offer.workshop.states.map_state import MapState

TITLE = "Archivierte Stories"
EMPTY = "Es gibt keine archivierten Stories."
NO_MATCH = "Keine Story passt zur Suche."
HINT = "Wählen Sie pro Story die Aufgabe, unter der sie wieder erscheint."
SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER = "Schlüssel, Titel oder Ort suchen"
TASK_PLACEHOLDER = "Aufgabe wählen"
RESTORE = "Wiederherstellen"
SELECT_WIDTH = 220
ROW_PX = 58
ROW_GAP_PX = 6
VISIBLE_ROWS = 4
LIST_HEIGHT = f"{VISIBLE_ROWS * ROW_PX + (VISIBLE_ROWS - 1) * ROW_GAP_PX}px"
"""Fixed height for four rows, so searching never resizes the dialog."""
ROW_STYLE = {
    "border": f"1px solid {theme.BORDER}",
    "borderRadius": "8px",
    "background": theme.SURFACE,
}

Story = ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]


def _entry(story: Story) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        mn.stack(
            mn.group(
                mn.text(story["key"], fz="xs", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, style=theme.NUMERIC),
                mn.text(story["where"], fz="xs", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, truncate="end"),
                gap=8,
                wrap="nowrap",
            ),
            mn.text(story["title"], fw=600, fz="sm"),
            gap=2,
            style={"flex": 1, "minWidth": 0},
        ),
        mn.select(
            data=MapState.task_groups,
            value=story["task"].to(str),
            placeholder=TASK_PLACEHOLDER,
            on_change=lambda picked: MapState.set_restore_task(  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                story["id"], picked
            ),
            allow_deselect=False,
            searchable=True,
            size="xs",
            w=SELECT_WIDTH,

"""The text editor of the selected chapter and the floating module toolbar."""

from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from reflex.components.component import NoSSRComponent
from reflex.event import EventHandler
from reflex.vars.base import Var

from appkit_mantine.base import MANTINE_VERSION
from appkit_mantine.tiptap import TIPTAP_VERSION

CONTROL_GROUPS = [["bold", "italic"], ["h3", "h4"], ["bulletList", "orderedList"]]
HISTORY_CONTROLS = [["undo", "redo"]]
EDITOR_LABELS = {
    "boldControlLabel": "Fett",
    "italicControlLabel": "Kursiv",
    "h3ControlLabel": "Zwischenüberschrift",
    "h4ControlLabel": "Kleine Zwischenüberschrift",
    "bulletListControlLabel": "Aufzählung",
    "orderedListControlLabel": "Nummerierte Liste",
    "undoControlLabel": "Rückgängig",
    "redoControlLabel": "Wiederholen",
}
TOOLBAR_CLASS = "aq-doc-toolbar"
PROSE_CLASS = "aq-doc-prose"


class ChapterEditor(NoSSRComponent):
    """Tiptap with Mantine; the children join the controls in the toolbar card."""

    library = rx.asset("chapter_editor.jsx", shared=True).importable_path
    tag = "ChapterEditor"
    lib_dependencies: list[str] = [
        f"@mantine/tiptap@{MANTINE_VERSION}",
        f"@tiptap/react@{TIPTAP_VERSION}",
        f"@tiptap/pm@{TIPTAP_VERSION}",
        f"@tiptap/starter-kit@{TIPTAP_VERSION}",
    ]

    content: Var[str]
    editable: Var[bool]
    control_groups: Var[list[list[str]]]
    toolbar_class_name: Var[str]
    content_class_name: Var[str]
    labels: Var[dict[str, str]]
    header: Var[rx.Component]
    """Shown above the text, below the toolbar row (the chapter title)."""

    on_update: EventHandler[lambda html: [html]]

    def add_imports(self) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
        return {
            "react": ["lazy"],
            f"$/{rx.constants.Dirs.UTILS}/context": ["ClientSide"],
        }


def chapter_editor(*toolbar: rx.Component, **props: Any) -> rx.Component:
    return ChapterEditor.create(
        *toolbar,
        control_groups=CONTROL_GROUPS + HISTORY_CONTROLS,
        toolbar_class_name=TOOLBAR_CLASS,
        content_class_name=PROSE_CLASS,
        labels=EDITOR_LABELS,
        **props,
    )


def floating_toolbar(*children: rx.Component) -> rx.Component:
