"""Text chapters: the HTML of the stored text, or the editor when selected."""

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons import theme

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.chapters.blocks import Row
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.chapters.editor import (
    PROSE_CLASS,
    chapter_editor,
    floating_toolbar,
    tool_button,
    toolbar_separator,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.chapter_state import (
    SHORTEN,
    TECHNICAL,
    ChapterState,
)

SHORTEN_LABEL = "KI: Kürzen"
TECHNICAL_LABEL = "Technischer"
OWN_LABEL = "Eigene Anweisung …"
OWN_PLACEHOLDER = "z. B. „Nenne die Annahmen zuerst“"
OWN_SUBMIT = "Vorschlag anfordern"
EDIT_DEBOUNCE_MS = 800


def view(chapter: Row) -> rx.Component:
    return rx.html(chapter["html"].to(str), class_name=PROSE_CLASS)


def _ai_tools() -> list[rx.Component]:
    blocked = ChapterState.chapter_locked | ChapterState.drafting
    return [
        toolbar_separator(),
        tool_button(
            SHORTEN_LABEL,
            disabled=blocked,
            on_click=ChapterState.draft_active(SHORTEN),
        ),
        tool_button(
            TECHNICAL_LABEL,
            disabled=blocked,
            on_click=ChapterState.draft_active(TECHNICAL),
        ),
        mn.popover(
            mn.popover.target(tool_button(OWN_LABEL, disabled=blocked)),
            mn.popover.dropdown(
                mn.stack(
                    mn.textarea(
                        placeholder=OWN_PLACEHOLDER,
                        value=ChapterState.instruction,
                        on_change=ChapterState.set_instruction,
                        autosize=True,
                        min_rows=2,
                        w=280,
                    ),
                    mn.button(
                        OWN_SUBMIT,
                        size="xs",
                        loading=ChapterState.drafting,
                        on_click=ChapterState.draft_active(""),
                    ),
                    gap=8,
                ),
            ),
            position="bottom-end",
            shadow="md",
            z_index=theme.PAGE_POPOVER_Z_INDEX,
        ),
    ]


def editing(chapter: Row, header: rx.Component) -> rx.Component:
    """The editor with the same typography; content the editor cannot hold stays
    read-only with a note."""
    return rx.cond(
        ChapterState.editable,
        chapter_editor(
            *_ai_tools(),
            content=ChapterState.editor_html,
            editable=~ChapterState.chapter_locked,
            on_update=lambda html: ChapterState.autosave(  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                ChapterState.active_key, html
            ).debounce(EDIT_DEBOUNCE_MS),
            key=ChapterState.editor_key,
            header=header,
        ),
        rx.fragment(
            floating_toolbar(*_ai_tools()[1:]),
            header,
            mn.text(ChapterState.note, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
            view(chapter),
        ),
    )

"""The outline column: frame entries, chapters to drag, "+ Kapitel"."""

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.sortable import sortable_list

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.chapters.blocks import Row
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.chapters.labels import TYPE_SHORT, by_type
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.chapter_state import ChapterState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.review_state import ReviewState

TITLE = "Gliederung"
ADD = "+ Kapitel"
DRAFT_ALL = "Fehlende Kapitel vorschlagen"
OUTLINE_LABEL = "Gliederung des Angebots"
DRAG_HINT = "Ziehen oder mit Leertaste und Pfeiltasten verschieben"
STATUS = {
    "blocker": ("Blocker", theme.NEGATIVE),
    "findings": ("Befunde", theme.WARNING),
    "review": ("Bitte prüfen", theme.WARNING),
    "proposal": ("Vorschlag", theme.ACCENT),
}


def _dot(label: str, color: str) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.tooltip(
        rx.el.span(
            class_name="aq-doc-dot",
            style={"background": color},
            aria_label=label,
            role="img",
        ),
        label=label,
        z_index=theme.PAGE_POPOVER_Z_INDEX,
    )


def _status(chapter: Row) -> rx.Component:
    key = chapter["key"].to(str)
    return rx.fragment(
        rx.cond(
            ReviewState.blocker_keys.contains(key),
            _dot(*STATUS["blocker"]),
            rx.cond(ReviewState.other_keys.contains(key), _dot(*STATUS["findings"])),
        ),
        rx.cond(chapter["needs_review"].to(bool), _dot(*STATUS["review"])),
        rx.cond(chapter["proposal"].to(bool), _dot(*STATUS["proposal"])),
        rx.cond(
            chapter["protected"].to(bool),
            mn.tooltip(
                rx.icon("lock", size=12, color=theme.TEXT_MUTED, aria_label="Geschützt"),
                label="Geschützt",
                z_index=theme.PAGE_POPOVER_Z_INDEX,
            ),
        ),
    )


def _row(chapter: Row) -> rx.Component:
    key = chapter["key"].to(str)
    return rx.el.div(
        rx.el.span(rx.icon("grip-vertical", size=14), class_name="aq-doc-grip"),
        rx.el.span(
            chapter["number"].to(str) + " " + chapter["title"].to(str),
            class_name="aq-doc-row-title",
        ),
        _status(chapter),
        rx.el.span(by_type(chapter["type"], TYPE_SHORT), class_name="aq-doc-type"),
        class_name="aq-doc-row",
        custom_attrs={
            "data-active": rx.cond(ChapterState.active_key == key, "true", "false"),
            "data-level": chapter["level"].to(str),
        },
        title=DRAG_HINT,
        on_click=ChapterState.jump_to(key),
    )


def _frame(title: rx.Var[str]) -> rx.Component:
    return rx.el.div(title, class_name="aq-doc-frame-entry")


def outline() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.el.nav(
        rx.el.div(
            mn.text(TITLE, fz="11.5px", fw=600, c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
            mn.button(
                ADD,
                variant="subtle",
                size="compact-sm",
                on_click=ChapterState.open_add,
            ),
            class_name="aq-doc-outline-head",
        ),
        rx.foreach(ChapterState.frame_before, _frame),
        sortable_list(
            rx.foreach(ChapterState.chapters, _row),
            ids=ChapterState.chapter_ids,
            disabled_ids=ChapterState.locked_ids,
            droppable_id="chapters",
            item_class_name="aq-doc-sortable-item",
            on_reorder=ChapterState.reorder,
        ),
        rx.foreach(ChapterState.frame_after, _frame),
        mn.button(
            DRAFT_ALL,
            variant="default",
            size="xs",
            mt=12,
            loading=ChapterState.drafting,
            on_click=ChapterState.draft_all,
        ),
        class_name="aq-doc-outline",
        aria_label=OUTLINE_LABEL,
    )

"""The chapter panel on the right: settings, AI proposal, findings, history."""

from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.list_view import inspector, inspector_section
from alloq_commons.components.toolbar import segmented

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.chapters.blocks import Row
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.chapters.blocks.calc import CALC_SECTION_ID
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.chapters.labels import (
    TYPE_HINTS,
    TYPE_LABELS,
    by_type,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.components.review_panel import calc_section, findings_section
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.chapter_panel_mixin import GROUP_OPTIONS
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.chapter_state import ChapterState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.outline_mixin import LEVEL_OPTIONS
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.workshop_state import TAB_MAP, WorkshopState

PANEL_LABEL = "Kapitel"
TYPE_PREFIX = "Kapiteltyp · "
HEADING = "Überschrift"
LEVEL = "Ebene"
GUIDE_TITLE = "Leitfrage"
RULES_TITLE = "Regeln"
GROUP_BY = "Gruppieren nach"
STORIES_NOTE = (
    "Die Stories kommen aus der Story Map. Die Map selbst erscheint nicht im "
    "Dokument."
)
OPEN_MAP = "Story Map öffnen"
COLUMNS = "Spalten"
PROTECTED_LABEL = "Kapitel schützen"
MOVE_UP = "Nach oben"
MOVE_DOWN = "Nach unten"
REMOVE = "Entfernen"
REQUIRED_NOTE = "Pflichtkapitel bleiben im Angebot."
REMOVED_TITLE = "Entfernte Kapitel"
RESTORE = "Wiederherstellen"
NOTHING_SELECTED = "Wählen Sie ein Kapitel im Dokument aus."
PROPOSAL_TITLE = "KI-Vorschlag"
PROPOSAL_HINT = (
    "Der Vorschlag ändert das Kapitel erst, wenn Sie ihn übernehmen. "
    "Er bestätigt keine fachliche Entscheidung."
)
ACCEPT = "Vorschlag übernehmen"
REJECT = "Verwerfen"
HISTORY = "Verlauf"
HISTORY_CLOSE = "Verlauf schließen"
HISTORY_RESTORE = "Wiederherstellen"
WORKING_LABEL = "Die KI arbeitet …"


def _diff_line(line: Row) -> rx.Component:
    kind = line["kind"].to(str)
    return mn.text(
        rx.cond(kind == "added", "+ ", rx.cond(kind == "removed", "- ", "  "))
        + line["text"].to(str),
        fz="12px",
        lh="1.5",
        c=rx.cond(
            kind == "added",
            theme.POSITIVE,
            rx.cond(kind == "removed", theme.NEGATIVE, theme.TEXT),
        ),
        style={"whiteSpace": "pre-wrap"},
    )


def _proposal() -> rx.Component:
    return inspector_section(
        PROPOSAL_TITLE,
        mn.text(PROPOSAL_HINT, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, lh="1.5"),
        mn.stack(
            rx.foreach(
                ChapterState.proposal["diff"].to(list[dict[str, Any]]), _diff_line
            ),
            gap=0,
        ),
        mn.group(
            mn.button(
                ACCEPT,
                size="xs",
                disabled=ChapterState.chapter_locked,
                on_click=ChapterState.accept_proposal,
            ),
            mn.button(
                REJECT,
                variant="subtle",
                size="xs",
                on_click=ChapterState.reject_proposal,
            ),
        ),
    )


def _history_entry(entry: Row) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.group(
            mn.text(
                "Revision "
                + entry["number"].to(str)
                + " · "
                + entry["origin"].to(str)
                + " · "
                + entry["created"].to(str),
                fz="12px",
                fw=600,
            ),
            mn.button(
                HISTORY_RESTORE,
                variant="subtle",
                size="compact-xs",
                on_click=ChapterState.restore(entry["number"].to(int)),
            ),
            justify="space-between",
        ),
        mn.text(entry["author"].to(str), fz="11px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
        rx.foreach(entry["diff"].to(list[dict[str, Any]]), _diff_line),
        gap=2,
        py=8,
        style={"borderTop": f"1px solid {theme.SEPARATOR}"},
    )


def _history() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.cond(
        ChapterState.history_open,
        inspector_section(
            HISTORY,
            mn.button(
                HISTORY_CLOSE,
                variant="subtle",
                size="compact-xs",
                on_click=ChapterState.close_history,
            ),
            mn.stack(rx.foreach(ChapterState.history, _history_entry), gap=0),
        ),
        mn.button(
            HISTORY, variant="default", size="xs", on_click=ChapterState.open_history
        ),
    )


def _head(active: Row) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.text(
            TYPE_PREFIX + by_type(active["type"], TYPE_LABELS),
            fz="11.5px",
            fw=600,
            c=theme.TEXT_MUTED,
        ),
        mn.text(
            active["number"].to(str) + " " + active["title"].to(str),
            fz="15px",
            fw=650,
        ),
        mn.text(ChapterState.status_line, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
        gap=2,
    )


def _settings(active: Row) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.text_input(
            label=HEADING,
            default_value=active["title"].to(str),
            on_blur=ChapterState.rename_active,
            disabled=ChapterState.chapter_locked,
            custom_attrs={"maxLength": 255},
            key=ChapterState.active_key + "-" + active["title"].to(str),
            size="xs",
        ),
        mn.stack(
            mn.text(LEVEL, fz="12px", fw=600),
            segmented(
                active["level"].to(str),
                ChapterState.set_active_level,
                LEVEL_OPTIONS,
                disabled=ChapterState.chapter_locked | ChapterState.is_first,
            ),
            gap=4,
        ),
        mn.text(by_type(active["type"], TYPE_HINTS), fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
        gap=10,
    )


def _type_settings(active: Row) -> rx.Component:
    return rx.match(
        active["type"].to(str),
        (
            "stories",
            inspector_section(
                GROUP_BY,
                segmented(
                    active["group_by"].to(str),
                    ChapterState.set_group_by,
                    GROUP_OPTIONS,
                    disabled=ChapterState.chapter_locked,
                ),
                mn.text(STORIES_NOTE, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                mn.anchor(
                    OPEN_MAP,
                    fz="12px",
                    fw=500,
                    on_click=WorkshopState.set_tab(TAB_MAP),
                ),
            ),
        ),
        (
            "table",
            inspector_section(
                COLUMNS,
                mn.text(
                    active["columns"].to(list[str]).join(" · "),
                    fz="12px",
                    c=theme.TEXT_MUTED,
                ),
            ),
        ),
        ("calc", rx.box(calc_section(), id=CALC_SECTION_ID)),
        rx.fragment(),
    )


def _guide(active: Row) -> rx.Component:
    return rx.fragment(
        rx.cond(
            active["guiding_question"].to(str) != "",
            inspector_section(
                GUIDE_TITLE,
                mn.text(active["guiding_question"].to(str), fz="13px", lh="1.5"),
            ),
        ),
        rx.cond(
            active["rules"].to(list[str]).length() > 0,
            inspector_section(
                RULES_TITLE,
                rx.foreach(
                    active["rules"].to(list[str]),
                    lambda rule: mn.text("· " + rule, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    )


def _actions(active: Row) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.switch(
            label=PROTECTED_LABEL,
            checked=active["protected"].to(bool),
            on_change=ChapterState.set_protected,
        ),
        mn.group(
            mn.button(
                MOVE_UP,
                variant="default",
                size="xs",
                disabled=ChapterState.is_first | ChapterState.chapter_locked,
                on_click=ChapterState.move_active(-1),
            ),
            mn.button(
                MOVE_DOWN,
                variant="default",
                size="xs",
                disabled=ChapterState.is_last | ChapterState.chapter_locked,
                on_click=ChapterState.move_active(1),
            ),
            rx.cond(
                active["required"].to(bool),
                mn.text(REQUIRED_NOTE, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                mn.button(
                    REMOVE,
                    variant="subtle",
                    color="red",
                    size="xs",
                    disabled=ChapterState.chapter_locked,
                    on_click=ChapterState.ask_remove,
                ),
            ),
            gap=6,
        ),
        gap=10,
        pt=12,
        style={"borderTop": f"1px solid {theme.SEPARATOR}"},
    )


def _removed() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.cond(
        ChapterState.has_removed,
        inspector_section(
            REMOVED_TITLE,
            rx.foreach(
                ChapterState.removed_chapters,
                lambda chapter: mn.group(
                    mn.text(chapter["title"], fz="12px", style={"flex": 1}),
                    mn.button(
                        RESTORE,
                        variant="subtle",
                        size="compact-xs",
                        on_click=ChapterState.restore_chapter(chapter["key"]),
                    ),
                    justify="space-between",
                    wrap="nowrap",
                ),
            ),
        ),
    )


def _selected() -> rx.Component:
    active = ChapterState.active
    return mn.stack(
        _head(active),
        _settings(active),
        _type_settings(active),
        _guide(active),
        rx.cond(ChapterState.drafting, mn.text(WORKING_LABEL, fz="12px")),
        rx.cond(ChapterState.has_proposal, _proposal()),
        findings_section(),
        _history(),
        _actions(active),
        gap=16,
    )


def panel() -> rx.Component:
    return inspector(
        rx.cond(
            ChapterState.has_active,
            _selected(),
            mn.text(NOTHING_SELECTED, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
        ),
        _removed(),
        label=PANEL_LABEL,
        wide=False,
    )

from alloq_offer.workshop.components.chapters.labels import TYPE_SHORT, by_type

    ADD_TABS,
    TAB_LIBRARY,
    TYPE_OPTIONS,
)

ADD_HINT = "Das neue Kapitel kommt hinter das ausgewählte Kapitel."
LIBRARY_EMPTY = "Alle aktiven Bausteine sind schon im Angebot."
BLANK_TITLE = "Überschrift"
BLANK_TYPE = "Kapiteltyp"
INSERT = "Einfügen"
CANCEL = "Abbrechen"

    "Das Kapitel verschwindet aus dem Dokument. Text, Verlauf und Befunde bleiben "
    "erhalten; unter „Entfernte Kapitel“ holen Sie es zurück."
)
REMOVE = "Entfernen"
OVERLAY = {"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4}


def _block(block: Any) -> rx.Component:
    return rx.el.button(
        mn.group(
            mn.text(block["title"], fw=650, fz="13px", style={"flex": 1}),
            rx.el.span(by_type(block["type"], TYPE_SHORT), class_name="aq-doc-type"),
            wrap="nowrap",
        ),
        mn.text(block["description"], fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, lh="1.4"),
        type="button",
        class_name="aq-doc-library-item",
        on_click=ChapterState.add_block(block["key"]),
    )


def _library() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.cond(
        ChapterState.library.length() > 0,
        rx.el.div(
            rx.foreach(ChapterState.library, _block),
            class_name="aq-doc-library",
        ),
        mn.text(LIBRARY_EMPTY, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, py=12),
    )


def _blank() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.text_input(
            label=BLANK_TITLE,
            value=ChapterState.blank_title,
            on_change=ChapterState.set_blank_title,
            custom_attrs={"maxLength": 255},
            data_autofocus=True,
        ),
        mn.stack(
            mn.text(BLANK_TYPE, fz="13px", fw=500),

"""Sortable list: a pinned drag and drop package and the reorder event."""

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons.components.sortable import DND_PACKAGE, SortableList, sortable_list


class _Order(rx.State):
    moved: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")

    @rx.event
    def reorder(self, key: str, index: int) -> None:
        self.moved = f"{key}:{index}"


def test_dnd_package_is_pinned_to_an_exact_version() -> None:
    name, _, version = DND_PACKAGE.rpartition("@")
    assert name == "@hello-pangea/dnd"
    assert version.count(".") == 2
    assert version[0].isdigit()
    assert DND_PACKAGE in SortableList.lib_dependencies


def test_sortable_list_renders_ids_children_and_the_event() -> None:
    rendered = str(
        sortable_list(
            rx.text("Eins"),
            rx.text("Zwei"),
            ids=["a", "b"],
            disabled_ids=["b"],
            on_reorder=_Order.reorder,
        )
    )
    assert "SortableList" in rendered
    assert 'ids:["a", "b"]' in rendered
    assert 'disabledIds:["b"]' in rendered
    assert "reorder" in rendered
    assert "Eins" in rendered

"""A list whose rows are reordered by drag and drop or the keyboard.

Built on ``@hello-pangea/dnd``: a row is lifted with the mouse, or focused and
moved with space and the arrow keys. Render each row as a ``sortable_item``
(also inside ``rx.foreach``) within one ``sortable_list``; ``on_reorder``
receives the moved id and its new index.
"""

from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from reflex.event import EventHandler
from reflex.vars.base import Var

DND_PACKAGE = "@hello-pangea/dnd@18.0.1"
_LIBRARY = rx.asset("sortable.jsx", shared=True).importable_path


class SortableList(rx.Component):
    library = _LIBRARY
    tag = "SortableList"
    lib_dependencies: list[str] = [DND_PACKAGE]

    ids: Var[list[str]]
    """The ids of the rows in their stored order."""

    droppable_id: Var[str]

    on_reorder: EventHandler[lambda key, index: [key, index]]


class SortableItem(rx.Component):
    library = _LIBRARY
    tag = "SortableItem"
    lib_dependencies: list[str] = [DND_PACKAGE]

    item_id: Var[str]
    index: Var[int]
    """The position of the row in the stored order."""

    disabled: Var[bool]
    """True when the row cannot be dragged."""


def sortable_list(*children: Any, **props: Any) -> rx.Component:
    return SortableList.create(*children, **props)


def sortable_item(*children: Any, **props: Any) -> rx.Component:
    return SortableItem.create(*children, **props)

"""The chapter library: reusable blocks with start content, AI settings and checks.

A block in use by a template draft is deactivated instead of deleted; offers
and published versions keep their own copies of its settings.
"""

import logging
from typing import Annotated, Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, ValidationError, field_validator
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

from alloq_offer.repository import german_sort_key
from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.template_package import ChapterDef, ChapterType
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.checks import CHAPTER_CHECKS
from alloq_offer.workshop.template_entities import (
    ChapterBlockEntity,
    OfferTemplateChapterEntity,
    OfferTemplateEntity,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

KEY_PATTERN = r"^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,49}$"
MAX_ITEMS = 20
NOT_FOUND = "Diesen Kapitelbaustein gibt es nicht."
DUPLICATE = "Diesen Schlüssel gibt es schon."
IN_USE = (
    "Der Baustein wird in einer Vorlage verwendet. Deaktivieren Sie ihn "
    "stattdessen."
)
FIELD_LABELS = {
    "key": "Schlüssel (Kleinbuchstaben, Ziffern und _, 2 bis 50 Zeichen)",
    "title": "Titel (höchstens 255 Zeichen)",
    "chapter_type": "Kapiteltyp",
    "level": "Ebene",
    "default_content": "Startinhalt",
    "guiding_question": "Leitfrage (höchstens 2000 Zeichen)",
    "content_rules": "Regeln (höchstens 20, je 500 Zeichen)",
    "prompt_text": "Prompt-Ergänzung (höchstens 4000 Zeichen)",
    "required_info": "Pflichtangaben (höchstens 20, je 200 Zeichen)",
    "checks": "Prüfungen",
}

Rule = Annotated[str, Field(max_length=500)]
Info = Annotated[str, Field(max_length=200)]


class BlockError(ValueError):
    """The block cannot be stored; the message is German and shown to admins."""


class BlockInput(BaseModel):
    """What an admin enters for a block."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(str_strip_whitespace=True)

    key: str = Field(pattern=KEY_PATTERN)
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=255)
    chapter_type: ChapterType
    level: Literal[1, 2] = 1
    default_content: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    guiding_question: str = Field(default="", max_length=2000)
    content_rules: list[Rule] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=MAX_ITEMS)
    prompt_text: str = Field(default="", max_length=4000)
    required_info: list[Info] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=MAX_ITEMS)
    checks: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    active: bool = True

    @field_validator("content_rules", "required_info", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _no_empty_items(cls, value: object) -> object:
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [str(item).strip() for item in value if str(item).strip()]
        return value

    @field_validator("checks")
    @classmethod
    def _known_checks(cls, value: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        if not set(value) <= set(CHAPTER_CHECKS):
            raise ValueError("unknown check")
        return list(dict.fromkeys(value))


def parse_block(data: dict[str, Any]) -> BlockInput:
    """Validate admin input; the content must fit the chapter type."""
    try:
        block = BlockInput.model_validate(data)
        ChapterDef.model_validate(block.model_dump())
    except ValidationError as exc:
        field = str(exc.errors()[0]["loc"][0]) if exc.errors()[0]["loc"] else ""
        label = FIELD_LABELS.get(field, FIELD_LABELS["default_content"])
        raise BlockError(f"Bitte prüfen Sie: {label}.") from exc
    return block


def _row(block: ChapterBlockEntity, used_in: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {**block.to_dict(), "used_in": used_in}


async def list_blocks(sessions: SessionFactory) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """All blocks by title, each with the templates whose draft uses it."""
    async with sessions() as session:
        blocks = (await session.scalars(select(ChapterBlockEntity))).all()
        usage = (
            await session.execute(
                select(OfferTemplateChapterEntity.block_id, OfferTemplateEntity.name)
                .join(OfferTemplateEntity)
                .order_by(OfferTemplateEntity.name)
            )
        ).all()
    used: dict[int, list[str]] = {}
    for block_id, name in usage:
        used.setdefault(block_id, []).append(name)
    return [
        _row(block, used.get(block.id, []))
        for block in sorted(blocks, key=lambda b: german_sort_key(b.title))
    ]


async def save_block(
    sessions: SessionFactory, block: BlockInput, *, create: bool
) -> None:
    """Create a block or change one; the key of a block never changes."""
    values = block.model_dump()
    try:
        async with sessions() as session:
            if create:
                session.add(ChapterBlockEntity(**values))
                await session.flush()
            else:
                row = await session.scalar(
                    select(ChapterBlockEntity).where(ChapterBlockEntity.key == block.key)
                )
                if row is None:
                    raise BlockError(NOT_FOUND)
                for name, value in values.items():
                    setattr(row, name, value)
    except IntegrityError as exc:
        raise BlockError(DUPLICATE) from exc
    logger.info("Chapter block %s %s", block.key, "created" if create else "changed")


async def delete_block(sessions: SessionFactory, key: str) -> None:
    """Delete an unused block; a block in a template draft stays."""
    async with sessions() as session:
        row = await session.scalar(
            select(ChapterBlockEntity).where(ChapterBlockEntity.key == key)
        )
        if row is None:
            raise BlockError(NOT_FOUND)
        used = await session.scalar(
            select(OfferTemplateChapterEntity.id)
            .where(OfferTemplateChapterEntity.block_id == row.id)
            .limit(1)
        )
        if used is not None:
            raise BlockError(IN_USE)
        await session.delete(row)
    logger.info("Chapter block %s deleted", key)

    @classmethod
    def _no_empty_items(cls, value: object) -> object:
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [str(item).strip() for item in value if str(item).strip()]
        return value

    @field_validator("checks")
    @classmethod
    def _known_checks(cls, value: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        if not set(value) <= set(CHAPTER_CHECKS):
            raise ValueError("unknown check")
        return list(dict.fromkeys(value))


def parse_block(data: dict[str, Any]) -> BlockInput:
    """Validate admin input; the content must fit the chapter type."""
    try:
        block = BlockInput.model_validate(data)
        ChapterDef.model_validate(block.model_dump())
    except ValidationError as exc:
        field = str(exc.errors()[0]["loc"][0]) if exc.errors()[0]["loc"] else ""
        label = FIELD_LABELS.get(field, FIELD_LABELS["default_content"])
        raise BlockError(f"Bitte prüfen Sie: {label}.") from exc
    return block


def _row(block: ChapterBlockEntity, used_in: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {**block.to_dict(), "used_in": used_in}


async def list_blocks(sessions: SessionFactory) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """All blocks by title, each with the templates whose draft uses it."""
    async with sessions() as session:
        blocks = (await session.scalars(select(ChapterBlockEntity))).all()
        usage = (
            await session.execute(
                select(OfferTemplateChapterEntity.block_id, OfferTemplateEntity.name)
                .join(OfferTemplateEntity)
                .order_by(OfferTemplateEntity.name)
            )
        ).all()
    used: dict[int, list[str]] = {}
    for block_id, name in usage:
        used.setdefault(block_id, []).append(name)
    return [
        _row(block, used.get(block.id, []))
        for block in sorted(blocks, key=lambda b: german_sort_key(b.title))
    ]


async def save_block(
    sessions: SessionFactory, block: BlockInput, *, create: bool
) -> None:
    """Create a block or change one; the key of a block never changes."""
    values = block.model_dump()
    try:
        async with sessions() as session:
            if create:
                session.add(ChapterBlockEntity(**values))
                await session.flush()
            else:
                row = await session.scalar(
                    select(ChapterBlockEntity).where(ChapterBlockEntity.key == block.key)
                )
                if row is None:
                    raise BlockError(NOT_FOUND)
                for name, value in values.items():
                    setattr(row, name, value)
    except IntegrityError as exc:
        raise BlockError(DUPLICATE) from exc
    logger.info("Chapter block %s %s", block.key, "created" if create else "changed")


async def delete_block(sessions: SessionFactory, key: str) -> None:
    """Delete an unused block; a block in a template draft stays."""
    async with sessions() as session:
        row = await session.scalar(
            select(ChapterBlockEntity).where(ChapterBlockEntity.key == key)
        )
        if row is None:
            raise BlockError(NOT_FOUND)
        used = await session.scalar(
            select(OfferTemplateChapterEntity.id)
            .where(OfferTemplateChapterEntity.block_id == row.id)
            .limit(1)
        )
        if used is not None:
            raise BlockError(IN_USE)
        await session.delete(row)
    logger.info("Chapter block %s deleted", key)

"""Template drafts in admin: outline, Word layout and publishing (spec 6.1).

The draft outline points at library blocks. Publishing copies the outline with
every block setting and the layout into a new immutable version; offers that
bound an older version are not touched.
"""

import io
import logging
import zipfile
from typing import Any

from pydantic import ValidationError
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.template_package import (
    SETTINGS_FIELDS,
    TemplateError,
    TemplatePackage,
    clean_layout,
    frame_headings,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.exports import DOCX_MIME
from alloq_offer.workshop.storage import BlobStore, BlobTooLargeError
from alloq_offer.workshop.template_entities import (
    ChapterBlockEntity,
    OfferTemplateChapterEntity,
    OfferTemplateEntity,
    OfferTemplateVersionEntity,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MAX_TITLE = 255
# A layout unpacks to at most this much, so a crafted zip cannot exhaust memory.
MAX_UNPACKED_BYTES = 200 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_PARTS = 2000
NOT_FOUND = "Diese Vorlage gibt es nicht."
NO_ENTRY = "Diesen Eintrag der Gliederung gibt es nicht."
NO_BLOCK = "Diesen aktiven Kapitelbaustein gibt es nicht."
BLOCK_IN_OUTLINE = "Der Baustein ist schon in der Gliederung."
NOT_DOCX = "Bitte laden Sie eine Word-Datei (.docx) hoch."
TOO_LARGE = "Die Datei ist zu groß."
NO_LAYOUT = "Bitte laden Sie zuerst ein Word-Layout hoch."
EMPTY_OUTLINE = "Die Gliederung braucht mindestens ein Kapitel."
TITLE_TOO_LONG = "Die Überschrift darf höchstens 255 Zeichen haben."
BAD_LEVEL = "Ein Kapitel hat die Ebene 1 oder 2."
INVALID_DRAFT = "Die Vorlage ist so nicht gültig. Bitte prüfen Sie die Bausteine."


class DraftError(ValueError):
    """The draft cannot be changed or published; the message is German."""


async def list_templates(sessions: SessionFactory) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    async with sessions() as session:
        rows = (
            await session.execute(
                select(
                    OfferTemplateEntity,
                    func.max(OfferTemplateVersionEntity.number),
                )
                .outerjoin(OfferTemplateVersionEntity)
                .group_by(OfferTemplateEntity.id)
                .order_by(OfferTemplateEntity.name)
            )
        ).all()
    return [
        {**template.to_dict(), "latest": latest or 0}
        for template, latest in rows
    ]


async def _template(session: AsyncSession, template_id: int) -> OfferTemplateEntity:
    template = await session.get(OfferTemplateEntity, template_id, with_for_update=True)
    if template is None:
        raise DraftError(NOT_FOUND)
    return template


async def _entries(
    session: AsyncSession, template_id: int
) -> list[tuple[OfferTemplateChapterEntity, ChapterBlockEntity]]:
    rows = await session.execute(
        select(OfferTemplateChapterEntity, ChapterBlockEntity)
        .join(ChapterBlockEntity)
        .where(OfferTemplateChapterEntity.template_id == template_id)
        .order_by(OfferTemplateChapterEntity.position, OfferTemplateChapterEntity.id)
    )
    return [(entry, block) for entry, block in rows.all()]


def _renumber(entries: list[OfferTemplateChapterEntity]) -> None:
    for position, entry in enumerate(entries):
        entry.position = position


async def load_outline(
    sessions: SessionFactory, template_id: int
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """The draft outline with the title and level each entry will publish."""
    async with sessions() as session:
        entries = await _entries(session, template_id)
    return [
        {
            "id": entry.id,
            "block_key": block.key,
            "block_title": block.title,
            "type": block.chapter_type,
            "title": entry.title or block.title,
            "title_override": entry.title or "",
            "level": entry.level or block.level,
            "required": entry.required,
            "active": block.active,
        }
        for entry, block in entries
    ]


class TemplateDraft:
    """Changes to the draft of one template; each locks the template row."""

    def __init__(self, sessions: SessionFactory, template_id: int) -> None:
        self._sessions = sessions
        self._template_id = template_id

    async def _entry(
        self, session: AsyncSession, entry_id: int
    ) -> OfferTemplateChapterEntity:
        await _template(session, self._template_id)
        entry = await session.get(OfferTemplateChapterEntity, entry_id)
        if entry is None or entry.template_id != self._template_id:
            raise DraftError(NO_ENTRY)
        return entry

    async def add_block(self, block_key: str) -> None:
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            await _template(session, self._template_id)
            block = await session.scalar(
                select(ChapterBlockEntity).where(
                    ChapterBlockEntity.key == block_key, ChapterBlockEntity.active
                )
            )
            if block is None:
                raise DraftError(NO_BLOCK)
            entries = [entry for entry, _ in await _entries(session, self._template_id)]
            if any(entry.block_id == block.id for entry in entries):
                raise DraftError(BLOCK_IN_OUTLINE)
            session.add(
                OfferTemplateChapterEntity(
                    template_id=self._template_id,
                    block_id=block.id,
                    position=len(entries),
                    required=False,
                )
            )

    async def remove(self, entry_id: int) -> None:
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            entry = await self._entry(session, entry_id)
            await session.delete(entry)
            await session.flush()
            _renumber([e for e, _ in await _entries(session, self._template_id)])

    async def move(self, entry_id: int, index: int) -> None:
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            entry = await self._entry(session, entry_id)
            entries = [
                e
                for e, _ in await _entries(session, self._template_id)
                if e.id != entry.id
            ]
            entries.insert(max(0, min(index, len(entries))), entry)
            _renumber(entries)

    async def update(
        self, entry_id: int, *, required: bool, title: str, level: int | None
    ) -> None:
        """Required flag and the title and level that override the block's."""
        name = title.strip()
        if len(name) > MAX_TITLE:
            raise DraftError(TITLE_TOO_LONG)
        if level not in (None, 1, 2):
            raise DraftError(BAD_LEVEL)
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            entry = await self._entry(session, entry_id)
            entry.required = required
            entry.title = name or None
            entry.level = level

    async def upload_layout(self, store: BlobStore, filename: str, data: bytes) -> None:
        """Check, clean and keep a Word layout; its frame headings are read off it."""
        if not filename.lower().endswith(".docx"):
            raise DraftError(NOT_DOCX)
        _check_zip(data)
        try:
            cleaned = clean_layout(data)
            before, after = frame_headings(cleaned)
        except TemplateError as exc:
            raise DraftError(str(exc)) from exc
        try:
            blob_id = await store.put(cleaned, DOCX_MIME)
        except BlobTooLargeError as exc:
            raise DraftError(TOO_LARGE) from exc
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            template = await _template(session, self._template_id)
            template.draft_layout_blob_id = blob_id
            template.frame_before = before
            template.frame_after = after
        logger.info("Layout of template %s replaced", self._template_id)

    async def publish(self, user: str, layout: bytes) -> int:
        """Store the draft as the next immutable version; returns its number."""
        async with self._sessions() as session:
            template = await _template(session, self._template_id)
            if template.draft_layout_blob_id is None:
                raise DraftError(NO_LAYOUT)
            entries = await _entries(session, self._template_id)
            if not entries:
                raise DraftError(EMPTY_OUTLINE)
            payload = {
                "chapters": [_resolved(entry, block) for entry, block in entries],
                "frame_before": list(template.frame_before),
                "frame_after": list(template.frame_after),
            }
            try:
                TemplatePackage.model_validate(
                    {**payload, "key": template.key, "version": "0", "layout_bytes": layout}
                )
            except (ValidationError, TemplateError) as exc:
                raise DraftError(INVALID_DRAFT) from exc
            number = (
                await session.scalar(
                    select(func.max(OfferTemplateVersionEntity.number)).where(
                        OfferTemplateVersionEntity.template_id == template.id
                    )
                )
                or 0
            ) + 1
            session.add(
                OfferTemplateVersionEntity(
                    template_id=template.id,
                    number=number,
                    payload=payload,
                    layout_blob_id=template.draft_layout_blob_id,
                    published_by=user,
                )
            )
        logger.info("Template %s published as version %s", self._template_id, number)
        return number


def _resolved(
    entry: OfferTemplateChapterEntity, block: ChapterBlockEntity
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "key": block.key,
        "title": entry.title or block.title,
        "level": entry.level or block.level,
        "required": entry.required,
        "chapter_type": block.chapter_type,
        "default_content": block.default_content,
        **{name: getattr(block, name) for name in SETTINGS_FIELDS},
    }


def _check_zip(data: bytes) -> None:
    """Refuse files that are no zip or would unpack to too much."""
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as archive:
            parts = archive.infolist()
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise DraftError(NOT_DOCX) from exc
    if len(parts) > MAX_PARTS or sum(p.file_size for p in parts) > MAX_UNPACKED_BYTES:
        raise DraftError(TOO_LARGE)


async def list_versions(
    sessions: SessionFactory, template_id: int
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Published versions, newest first."""
    async with sessions() as session:
        rows = (
            await session.scalars(
                select(OfferTemplateVersionEntity)
                .where(OfferTemplateVersionEntity.template_id == template_id)
                .order_by(OfferTemplateVersionEntity.number.desc())
            )
        ).all()
    return [
        {
            "number": row.number,
            "published_by": row.published_by,
            "created": row.created.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
            "chapters": len(row.payload.get("chapters", [])),
        }
        for row in rows
    ]


async def draft_layout(sessions: SessionFactory, template_id: int) -> bytes | None:
    """The layout bytes of the draft, for the check before publishing."""
    async with sessions() as session:
        template = await session.get(OfferTemplateEntity, template_id)
        if template is None or template.draft_layout_blob_id is None:
            return None
    from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import BlobEntity  # noqa: PLC0415

    async with sessions() as session:
        return await session.scalar(
            select(BlobEntity.data).where(BlobEntity.id == template.draft_layout_blob_id)
        )

- Every new handler that reads or writes the database has `@rx.event` plus `@requires_offer_editor`:

  - `chapter_panel_mixin.py`: set_group_by, add_row, remove_row, add_column, rename_column, set_cell, add_value, remove_value
  - `chapter_state.py`: jump_to

- Data from other offers cannot be reached. The offer id always comes from server state (`open_offer_id` → `WorkshopState.offer_id`), never from the client. Every service lookup is filtered by that offer id: `find_chapter`, `live_chapters`, `_used_blocks` and `removed()` in `services/outline.py`, and `_locked`/`_check` in `services/chapters.py:374-396`.
- Library blocks are global, admin-maintained and filtered to active ones. `_content` is a backend-only variable, so the client cannot set it, and Reflex auto-setters are off by default in this version.

## Client-supplied arguments: no exploitable findings
- `index`, `row`, `column`: each is converted with `int()` and range-checked (`chapter_panel_mixin.py:85,106,118-120,142`). `move_chapter` clamps the target position (`outline.py:264`).
- `level`: checked against `LEVELS` (`outline.py:273`).
- `field`: must be in `BOUND_FIELDS` (`chapter_panel_mixin.py:131`, and the schema's `BoundFieldName`). `group_by` is checked against `GROUP_OPTIONS` plus a Literal type.
- Text: cells and column names are stripped and cut to `MAX_CELL` (`chapter_panel_mixin.py:34,105`). Titles go through `_title`: at most 255 characters, no control characters.
- Column count is capped at `MAX_COLUMNS` (`chapter_panel_mixin.py:94`). Every save also checks the revision and the chapter type.

- `data-bound` can only hold a `BOUND_FIELDS` key, because the schema validates it.

- `chapter_editor.jsx:34` turns off Tiptap's Link extension (`link: false`), so no `javascript:` links. Saved HTML is checked again server-side by `html_to_content`.

1. **The draft and the selected chapter can drift apart after a failed load** (`chapter_state.py:271-282`). This is about data integrity, not access.
   - `_select` sets `self.active_key = key` before calling `_load_active`.
   - If `service.load` raises, `_content` and `revision` still belong to the previously selected chapter.
   - A module edit made next (add_row, set_cell and so on) would save that chapter's table into the new key.
   - The revision check (`_locked`) and the type check (`_check`) stop this most of the time. They do not stop it when both are table chapters with the same revision number.
   - It needs a database error while loading, so it is rare. Fix: in the `except` branch of `_select`, reset `self.active_key = ""` and `self._content = {}` (or clear `_content` before loading).

- Table rows reach the prompt only through `<aktueller_text>`, and column names through `TABLE_TASK`. Both pass through `_tags`, which neutralises `<` and `>`, so they cannot close a delimiter.

"""Admin services: chapter blocks, template drafts with layout and publishing, prompts."""

import io

import pytest
from alloq_offer.workshop.content.schema import ProseContent
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.template_package import CHAPTER_ANCHOR
from alloq_offer.workshop.services import chapter_blocks, prompts, template_drafts
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.chapter_blocks import BlockError, parse_block
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.chapters import ChapterService
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.prompts import PromptError
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.template_drafts import DraftError, TemplateDraft
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.templates import latest_template
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.workspace import open_workspace
from alloq_offer.workshop.storage import DbBlobStore
from alloq_offer.workshop.template_entities import OfferTemplateEntity
from docx import Document
from sqlalchemy import select

BLOCK = {
    "key": "datenschutz",
    "title": " Datenschutz ",
    "chapter_type": "prose",
    "level": 2,
    "default_content": {"chapter_type": "prose"},
    "guiding_question": "Wie schützen wir Daten?",
    "content_rules": ["Keine Zusagen.", "  "],
    "prompt_text": "Nenne die DSGVO.",
    "required_info": ["Speicherort"],
    "checks": ["no_acceptance_criteria"],
}


def _layout(*before: str) -> bytes:
    document = Document()
    for heading in before:
        document.add_heading(heading, 1)
    document.add_paragraph(CHAPTER_ANCHOR)
    document.add_heading("Unterschriften", 1)
    document.core_properties.author = "Erika Muster"
    out = io.BytesIO()
    document.save(out)
    return out.getvalue()


async def _template_id(db) -> int:  # noqa: ANN001
    async with db.session() as session:
        template = await session.scalar(select(OfferTemplateEntity))
        assert template is not None
        return template.id


# --- blocks --------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_block_input_is_validated_in_german() -> None:
    block = parse_block(BLOCK)
    assert (block.title, block.content_rules) == ("Datenschutz", ["Keine Zusagen."])
    for change, label in (
        ({"key": "Daten Schutz"}, "Schlüssel"),
        ({"title": ""}, "Titel"),
        ({"checks": ["gibt_es_nicht"]}, "Prüfungen"),
        ({"default_content": {"chapter_type": "table", "columns": ["A"]}}, "Start"),
        ({"content_rules": ["x"] * 21}, "Regeln"),
    ):
        with pytest.raises(BlockError, match=label):
            parse_block({**BLOCK, **change})


async def test_blocks_are_created_changed_listed_and_deleted(db) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    await chapter_blocks.save_block(db.session, parse_block(BLOCK), create=True)
    with pytest.raises(BlockError, match=chapter_blocks.DUPLICATE):
        await chapter_blocks.save_block(db.session, parse_block(BLOCK), create=True)
    changed = parse_block({**BLOCK, "title": "Datenschutz und Betrieb", "active": False})
    await chapter_blocks.save_block(db.session, changed, create=False)
    rows = {b["key"]: b for b in await chapter_blocks.list_blocks(db.session)}
    assert rows["datenschutz"]["title"] == "Datenschutz und Betrieb"
    assert not rows["datenschutz"]["active"]
    assert rows["datenschutz"]["used_in"] == []
    assert rows["laufzeit"]["used_in"] == ["Angebot mit Story Map"]
    with pytest.raises(BlockError, match=chapter_blocks.IN_USE):
        await chapter_blocks.delete_block(db.session, "laufzeit")
    await chapter_blocks.delete_block(db.session, "datenschutz")
    with pytest.raises(BlockError, match=chapter_blocks.NOT_FOUND):
        await chapter_blocks.delete_block(db.session, "datenschutz")
    with pytest.raises(BlockError, match=chapter_blocks.NOT_FOUND):
        await chapter_blocks.save_block(db.session, parse_block(BLOCK), create=False)


# --- template drafts -----------------------------------------------------------


async def test_outline_entries_are_added_moved_changed_and_removed(db) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    template_id = await _template_id(db)
    draft = TemplateDraft(db.session, template_id)
    await chapter_blocks.save_block(db.session, parse_block(BLOCK), create=True)
    await draft.add_block("datenschutz")
    with pytest.raises(DraftError, match=template_drafts.BLOCK_IN_OUTLINE):
        await draft.add_block("datenschutz")
    with pytest.raises(DraftError, match=template_drafts.NO_BLOCK):
        await draft.add_block("gibt_es_nicht")
    outline = await template_drafts.load_outline(db.session, template_id)
    added = outline[-1]
    assert (added["block_key"], added["level"], added["required"]) == (
        "datenschutz",
        2,
        False,
    )
    await draft.move(added["id"], 0)
    await draft.update(added["id"], required=True, title=" Schutz ", level=1)
    outline = await template_drafts.load_outline(db.session, template_id)
    assert (outline[0]["title"], outline[0]["level"], outline[0]["required"]) == (
        "Schutz",
        1,
        True,
    )
    with pytest.raises(DraftError, match=template_drafts.BAD_LEVEL):
        await draft.update(added["id"], required=True, title="", level=3)
    with pytest.raises(DraftError, match=template_drafts.TITLE_TOO_LONG):
        await draft.update(added["id"], required=True, title="x" * 256, level=None)
    await draft.remove(added["id"])
    outline = await template_drafts.load_outline(db.session, template_id)
    assert outline[0]["block_key"] == "management_summary"
    with pytest.raises(DraftError, match=template_drafts.NO_ENTRY):
        await draft.remove(added["id"])
    with pytest.raises(DraftError, match=template_drafts.NOT_FOUND):
        await TemplateDraft(db.session, 999).add_block("laufzeit")

Line numbers in `chapter_state.py` are from the version on disk, which changed during the review (it moved by about 3 lines).
  
  ### High
  
  **1. Toggling "Kapitel schützen" empties every block in the document.**
  - Where: `states/chapter_state.py:342-353` (`set_protected`).
  - Cause: it does `self.chapters = await service.open()`. `open()` returns only the outline views. The render data that `load_document` merges in (`html`, `columns`, `rows`, `values`, `intro`, `groups`, `group_by`) is lost.
  - Effect: every prose block shows nothing, tables have no rows, and story and value blocks are empty until the next reload.
  - Fix: `await self._reload(service, await open_offer_id(self))` instead of `service.open()`.
  - Test gap: `test_workshop_chapter_state.py:135` only checks `chapter_locked`. Add an assert that `state.chapters[i]["html"]` is still set after the toggle.
  
  **2. The last edits are silently lost when the user clicks elsewhere within 800 ms of typing.**
  - Where: `blocks/prose.py:70-72` (`autosave(...).debounce(800)`), the guard `key != self.active_key or not self.editable` in `autosave` (`chapter_state.py:305`), and the new `clear_selection` (`chapter_state.py:295`, wired on `document.py:104`).
  - Cause: the debounced event already carries key A. If the user clicks another block, the outline or the page margin, `select_chapter` or `clear_selection` runs first and changes `active_key`. The guard then returns with no save and no toast. The old layout had the same guard, but now any click beside the block ends editing, so this happens far more often.
  - Fix, either of:
    - Let `autosave` save against the chapter's own revision from `self.chapters` (which `_touch` keeps current) instead of requiring the key to be active. The `ChapterConflictError` check still protects against stale editors. Check that the chapter type is prose instead of using `self.editable`.
    - Add an undebounced `on_blur` prop to `ChapterEditor` (tiptap `onBlur: ({editor}) => onBlur(editor.getHTML())`) that flushes the save.
  
  ### Medium
  
  **3. Every reload remounts the text editor, so focus and the cursor are lost.**
  - Where: `_load_active` (`chapter_state.py:202`) always does `editor_nonce += 1`, and `editor_key` is the `key` of `ChapterEditor`. `_reload` always calls `_load_active`.
  - When it happens: a draft job finishes while the user types (the `refresh_drafts` poll every 3 s), any outline change (drag, level, add, restore), and any module edit.
  - Effect: focus and cursor are lost. Text typed but not yet sent is overwritten by `editor_html`, which makes item 2 worse.
  - Fix: bump the nonce only when `active_key` or `revision` actually changed. `chapter_editor.jsx:41-50` already syncs outside content while the editor is not focused.
  
  **4. Uncontrolled inputs keep showing text the server rejected.**
  - Where:
    - Heading field: `panel.py:174`, keyed by `active_key + "-" + title`.
    - Table cells: `table.py:94`, keyed by `r-c-text`.
    - Column headers: `table.py:75`.
  - When it happens:

    - `rename_column` with an empty name: the handler returns silently (`chapter_panel_mixin.py:106`).
    - `set_cell` hitting `ChapterError`: `_save_content` does not reload.
    - A conflict where the stored cell text is unchanged.
  - Effect: in all of these, the input shows a value that was not saved.
  - Fix: add `input_reset: rx.Field[int]`. Bump it on the error paths of `_outline_change` and `_save_content` and on the early returns in `rename_column` and `rename_active`, and include it in those keys. Do not use `revision` in the keys: it would remount the cell the user just moved into.
  
  **5. A failed drag-and-drop move leaves the outline in the wrong order.**

git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
feat(offer): show the Kapitel tab as one document with outline and panel

Phase 4 of the plan "Angebot: Kapitel und Vorlagen".

- Kapitel tab rebuilt under workshop/components/chapters/: outline with the
  template frame (greyed, fixed), numbered chapters, type badges and status
  dots; the page with every chapter as a block and the frame as placeholder
  blocks "Aus der Word-Vorlage"; the chapter panel on the right.
- Only the selected block is edited, in the same typography as the read-only
  text: text through a small Tiptap wrapper (chapter_editor.jsx) whose
  controls sit in a floating toolbar card on the block's top edge (sticky
  while the chapter scrolls, never over the title, below dialogs); tables
  edited in place (+ Zeile, + Spalte, rename columns, remove rows); stories
  grouped by activity or slice; bound values added or removed. Text, tables
  and values have AI suggestions (tables get rows for their columns).
- Drag and drop and keyboard reordering through a new SortableList and
  SortableItem in alloq_commons (@hello-pangea/dnd 18.0.1, German screen
  reader instructions), plus "Nach oben" / "Nach unten" in the panel.
- "+ Kapitel" dialog with library blocks or a blank chapter of a type; a
  blank chapter takes the level of the chapter it follows. Removal asks for
  confirmation and lists removed chapters to restore.
- ChapterState gets OutlineMixin and ChapterPanelMixin; database helpers
  stay in chapter_state.py. Text typed just before another click is still
  saved, a reload keeps the editor mounted, failed edits refresh inputs.
- Empty paragraphs from the editor are dropped, so a click into the text no
  longer creates a revision. Word export groups stories by the chapter's
  choice, slices in their order.

Deviations from the board and plan:
- The three AI text actions sit in one "KI" menu so the card fits one row;
  the custom instruction opens a small dialog.
- No export card in the panel; the Export tab already has it.
- Rows are removed by an icon per row instead of a toolbar button.
- Story scope is left out, as the plan says.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

"""Chapter library in the "Angebote" administration (tab "Kapitelbausteine")."""

import logging
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from typing import Any

import reflex as rx

from alloq_offer.workshop.content.editor_io import content_to_html, html_to_content
from alloq_offer.workshop.content.schema import (
    BOUND_FIELDS,
    ContentValidationError,
    ProseContent,
    parse_content,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.services import chapter_blocks
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.chapter_blocks import BlockError, parse_block
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session
from appkit_user.authentication.decorators import requires_admin

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

LOAD_ERROR = "Die Kapitelbausteine konnten nicht geladen werden."
SAVE_ERROR = "Der Kapitelbaustein konnte nicht gespeichert werden."
SAVED = "Der Kapitelbaustein wurde gespeichert."
DELETED = "Der Kapitelbaustein wurde gelöscht."
DEFAULT_COLUMNS = ["Punkt", "Beschreibung"]


def _start_content(form: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The start content of the block from the type specific fields."""
    kind = form["chapter_type"]
    if kind == "prose":
        return html_to_content(form["content_html"]).model_dump(mode="json")
    if kind == "table":
        return {"chapter_type": "table", "columns": form["columns"]}
    if kind == "stories":
        return {"chapter_type": "stories", "group_by": form["group_by"]}
    return {
        "chapter_type": "calc",
        "rows": [
            {"label": BOUND_FIELDS[field], "field": field}
            for field in form["fields"]
            if field in BOUND_FIELDS
        ],
    }


class BlockAdminState(rx.State):
    """Admins create, change, deactivate and delete chapter blocks."""

    blocks: rx.Field[list[dict[str, Any]]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    editor_open: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)
    creating: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)
    key: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    title: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    chapter_type: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("prose")
    level: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("1")
    guiding_question: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    content_rules: rx.Field[list[str]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    prompt_text: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    required_info: rx.Field[list[str]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    checks: rx.Field[list[str]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    active: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(True)
    content_html: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    columns: rx.Field[list[str]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    group_by: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("activity")
    fields: rx.Field[list[str]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    editor_nonce: rx.Field[int] = rx.field(0)

    @rx.var
    def used_in(self) -> list[str]:
        block = next((b for b in self.blocks if b["key"] == self.key), {})
        return block.get("used_in", [])

    @rx.event
    @requires_admin
    async def load_blocks(self) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        try:
            self.blocks = await chapter_blocks.list_blocks(get_asyncdb_session)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Loading the chapter blocks failed")
            yield rx.toast.error(LOAD_ERROR, position="top-right")

    def _fill(self, block: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        content = parse_content(block["default_content"])
        self.key = block["key"]
        self.title = block["title"]
        self.chapter_type = block["chapter_type"]
        self.level = str(block["level"])
        self.guiding_question = block["guiding_question"]
        self.content_rules = list(block["content_rules"])
        self.prompt_text = block["prompt_text"]
        self.required_info = list(block["required_info"])
        self.checks = list(block["checks"])
        self.active = block["active"]
        self.content_html = (
            content_to_html(content) if isinstance(content, ProseContent) else ""
        )
        self.columns = list(getattr(content, "columns", DEFAULT_COLUMNS))
        self.group_by = getattr(content, "group_by", "activity")
        self.fields = [row.field for row in getattr(content, "rows", [])]
        if not isinstance(content, ProseContent | type(None)) and block[
            "chapter_type"
        ] != "table":
            self.columns = DEFAULT_COLUMNS
        self.editor_nonce += 1
        self.editor_open = True

    @rx.event
    def open_create(self) -> None:
        self.creating = True
        self._fill(
            {
                "key": "",
                "title": "",
                "chapter_type": "prose",
                "level": 1,
                "default_content": {"chapter_type": "prose"},
                "guiding_question": "",
                "content_rules": [],
                "prompt_text": "",
                "required_info": [],
                "checks": [],
                "active": True,
            }
        )

    @rx.event
    def open_edit(self, key: str) -> None:
        block = next((b for b in self.blocks if b["key"] == key), None)
        if block is not None:
            self.creating = False
            self._fill(block)

    @rx.event
    def close_editor(self) -> None:
        self.editor_open = False

    @rx.event
    def set_field(self, name: str, value: Any) -> None:
        """One form field; only the known ones of the editor are set."""
        if name in FORM_FIELDS:
            setattr(self, name, value)

    def _form(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {name: getattr(self, name) for name in FORM_FIELDS}

    @rx.event
    @requires_admin
    async def save(self) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        form = self._form()
        try:
            data = {
                **form,
                "level": int(form["level"]),
                "default_content": _start_content(form),
            }
            block = parse_block(data)
            await chapter_blocks.save_block(
                get_asyncdb_session, block, create=self.creating
            )
            self.blocks = await chapter_blocks.list_blocks(get_asyncdb_session)
        except ContentValidationError as exc:
            yield rx.toast.error(" ".join(exc.messages), position="top-right")
            return
        except BlockError as exc:
            yield rx.toast.error(str(exc), position="top-right")
            return
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Saving chapter block %s failed", form["key"])
            yield rx.toast.error(SAVE_ERROR, position="top-right")
            return
        self.editor_open = False
        yield rx.toast.success(SAVED, position="top-right")

    @rx.event
    @requires_admin
    async def delete(self, key: str) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        try:
            await chapter_blocks.delete_block(get_asyncdb_session, key)
            self.blocks = await chapter_blocks.list_blocks(get_asyncdb_session)
        except BlockError as exc:
            yield rx.toast.error(str(exc), position="top-right")
            return
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Deleting chapter block %s failed", key)
            yield rx.toast.error(SAVE_ERROR, position="top-right")
            return
        self.editor_open = False
        yield rx.toast.success(DELETED, position="top-right")


FORM_FIELDS = (
    "key",
    "title",
    "chapter_type",
    "level",
    "guiding_question",
    "content_rules",
    "prompt_text",
    "required_info",
    "checks",
    "active",
    "content_html",
    "columns",
    "group_by",
    "fields",
)

"""Chapter library in the "Angebote" administration (tab "Kapitelbausteine")."""

import logging
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from typing import Any

import reflex as rx

from alloq_offer.workshop.content.editor_io import content_to_html, html_to_content
from alloq_offer.workshop.content.schema import (
    BOUND_FIELDS,
    ContentValidationError,
    ProseContent,
    parse_content,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.services import chapter_blocks
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.chapter_blocks import BlockError, parse_block
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session
from appkit_user.authentication.decorators import requires_admin

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

LOAD_ERROR = "Die Kapitelbausteine konnten nicht geladen werden."
SAVE_ERROR = "Der Kapitelbaustein konnte nicht gespeichert werden."
SAVED = "Der Kapitelbaustein wurde gespeichert."
DELETED = "Der Kapitelbaustein wurde gelöscht."
DEFAULT_COLUMNS = ["Punkt", "Beschreibung"]


def _start_content(form: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The start content of the block from the type specific fields."""
    kind = form["chapter_type"]
    if kind == "prose":
        return html_to_content(form["content_html"]).model_dump(mode="json")
    if kind == "table":
        return {"chapter_type": "table", "columns": form["columns"]}
    if kind == "stories":
        return {"chapter_type": "stories", "group_by": form["group_by"]}
    return {
        "chapter_type": "calc",
        "rows": [
            {"label": BOUND_FIELDS[field], "field": field}
            for field in form["fields"]
            if field in BOUND_FIELDS
        ],
    }


class BlockAdminState(rx.State):
    """Admins create, change, deactivate and delete chapter blocks."""

    blocks: rx.Field[list[dict[str, Any]]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    editor_open: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)
    creating: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)
    key: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    title: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    chapter_type: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("prose")
    level: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("1")
    guiding_question: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    content_rules: rx.Field[list[str]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    prompt_text: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    required_info: rx.Field[list[str]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    checks: rx.Field[list[str]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    active: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(True)
    content_html: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    columns: rx.Field[list[str]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    group_by: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("activity")
    fields: rx.Field[list[str]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    editor_nonce: rx.Field[int] = rx.field(0)

    @rx.var
    def used_in(self) -> list[str]:
        block = next((b for b in self.blocks if b["key"] == self.key), {})
        return block.get("used_in", [])

    @rx.event
    @requires_admin
    async def load_blocks(self) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        try:
            self.blocks = await chapter_blocks.list_blocks(get_asyncdb_session)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Loading the chapter blocks failed")
            yield rx.toast.error(LOAD_ERROR, position="top-right")

    def _fill(self, block: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        content = parse_content(block["default_content"])
        self.key = block["key"]
        self.title = block["title"]
        self.chapter_type = block["chapter_type"]
        self.level = str(block["level"])
        self.guiding_question = block["guiding_question"]
        self.content_rules = list(block["content_rules"])
        self.prompt_text = block["prompt_text"]
        self.required_info = list(block["required_info"])
        self.checks = list(block["checks"])
        self.active = block["active"]

            content_to_html(content) if isinstance(content, ProseContent) else ""
        )
        self.columns = list(getattr(content, "columns", DEFAULT_COLUMNS))
        self.group_by = getattr(content, "group_by", "activity")
        self.fields = [row.field for row in getattr(content, "rows", [])]
        if not isinstance(content, ProseContent | type(None)) and block[
            "chapter_type"
        ] != "table":
            self.columns = DEFAULT_COLUMNS
        self.editor_nonce += 1
        self.editor_open = True

    @rx.event
    def open_create(self) -> None:
        self.creating = True
        self._fill(
            {
                "key": "",
                "title": "",
                "chapter_type": "prose",
                "level": 1,
                "default_content": {"chapter_type": "prose"},
                "guiding_question": "",
                "content_rules": [],
                "prompt_text": "",
                "required_info": [],
                "checks": [],
                "active": True,
            }
        )

    @rx.event
    def open_edit(self, key: str) -> None:
        block = next((b for b in self.blocks if b["key"] == key), None)
        if block is not None:
            self.creating = False
            self._fill(block)

    def close_editor(self) -> None:

        if name in FORM_FIELDS:

    @rx.event
    @requires_admin
    async def save(self) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        form = self._form()
        try:
            data = {
                **form,
                "level": int(form["level"]),
                "default_content": _start_content(form),
            }
            block = parse_block(data)
            await chapter_blocks.save_block(
                get_asyncdb_session, block, create=self.creating
            )
            self.blocks = await chapter_blocks.list_blocks(get_asyncdb_session)
        except ContentValidationError as exc:
            yield rx.toast.error(" ".join(exc.messages), position="top-right")
            return
        except BlockError as exc:
            yield rx.toast.error(str(exc), position="top-right")
            return

            logger.exception("Saving chapter block %s failed", form["key"])
            yield rx.toast.error(SAVE_ERROR, position="top-right")
            return
        self.editor_open = False
        yield rx.toast.success(SAVED, position="top-right")

    @rx.event
    @requires_admin
    async def delete(self, key: str) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        try:
            await chapter_blocks.delete_block(get_asyncdb_session, key)
            self.blocks = await chapter_blocks.list_blocks(get_asyncdb_session)
        except BlockError as exc:
            yield rx.toast.error(str(exc), position="top-right")
            return
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Deleting chapter block %s failed", key)
            yield rx.toast.error(SAVE_ERROR, position="top-right")
            return
        self.editor_open = False
        yield rx.toast.success(DELETED, position="top-right")
